programme.title: Exclusiv VIP
programme.desc: Lumea mondenă îşi deschide larg uşile şi îi invită în culisele ei pe telespectatorii Prima TV. Moderatorul emisiunii este pregătit să îi descoasă pe invitaţi şi să le afle toate secretele. Exclusivităţi, momente emoţionante, discuţii între prieteni, voie bună şi relaxare!

programme.title: Iubiri vinovate
Perdona Nuestros Pecados
programme.desc: La începutul anilor ´50, Maria, fiica unei familii puternice din înalta aristocraţie chiliană se îndrăgosteşte, nepermis, de fiul unei servitoare! Preotul Reynaldo Suarez, nou venit în localitate, se îndrăgosteşte, la rândul său, de Maria! Pe cine să aleagă el? Credinţa sau iubirea? În această lume închistată în reguli şi prejudecăţi, dragostea, e singurul sentiment care circulă liber printre oameni şi care dărâmă prejudecăţi, provocând însă drame şi suferinţe.

Un format dinamic, rapid şi captivant, 50:50 aduce în prim-plan doi concurenţi care se confruntă într-o competiţie unde fiecare întrebare contează, iar şansele de câştig sunt mereu egale: 50% – 50%. Tot jocul se învârte în jurul numărului 50.

programme.title: Gata oricând! - Eroii de la Podul Jiului
programme.desc: În dimineața zilei de 14 octombrie 1916, când un tânăr cercetaș descoperă că temuta armată germană a ajuns nestingherită aproape de Târgu-Jiu, îl anunță în grabă pe comisarul orașului Ioan Popilian și, împreună cu câțiva polițiști și cercetași, ajutați de câțiva civili rămași în orașul deja evacuat, luptă la Podul Jiului pentru a opri ocuparea orașului de inamic până la sosirea armatei române. Ocuparea podului ar fi dus la ocuparea gării, lucru ce ar fi permis armatei germane să oprească… citeşte.

programme.title: Cursa iubirii
programme.desc: Gina Patrichi, Victor Rebengiuc, Luminița Gheorghiu.

programme.title: Ion: Blestemul pământului, blestemul iubirii
Blestemul pământului Blestemul iubirii
programme.desc: Ion (Șerban Ionescu), un țăran sărac din satul Prislop, vrea să intre și el în rândul celor bogați. Planul său este de a-l sili pe Vasile Baciu (Petre Gheorghiu), unul dintre bogătașii satului, să i-o dea de soție pe fiica sa, Ana (Ioana Crăciunescu), și, o dată cu ea, și pământurile. Ana rămâne însărcinată, iar Ion așteaptă momentul tocmelii. În același timp, Ion e îndrăgostit pătimaș de Florica (Sorina Stănculescu), o fată frumoasă, dar săracă. Ion ar dori și… citeşte.

programme.title: Poezie și delicatețuri
programme.desc: Un show în care ingredientele culinare sunt omniprezente iar sarea și piperul sunt adăugate de confesiunile invitaților. Poezie şi delicateţuri oferă o bună ocazie telespectatorului să intre într-o lume în care poezia este în orice, de la un pahar de vin până la povestea de viaţă a invitaţilor, iar bucătăria tradiţională este la ea acasă.

programme.title: Sănătate cu stil
programme.desc: Prezentatoarea emisiunii aduce în atenţia telespectatorilor o serie întreagă de afecţiuni, cu care se confruntă tot mai mulţi români, şi oferă cele mai bune soluţii şi remedii pentru acestea, cu ajutorul celor mai buni medici din România. Telespectatorii vor afla şi cum pot avea grija cel mai bine de sănătatea lor, cum se pot hrăni sănătos, ce beneficii aduce mişcarea în viaţa lor, cum pot trata cel mai bine afecţiuni de care le este teamă sau ruşine să vorbească, dar şi cum îşi pot asigura o stare de bine cu ajutorul leacurilor din natură, al plantelor care pot face adevărate miracole pentru sănătatea lor.

programme.title: Connect
programme.desc: Emisiunea Connect își propune să prezinte săptămânal cele mai noi și interesante gadgeturi, de la cele mai cunoscute telefoane, laptopuri, wearables, aplicații și jocuri, la cele mai inedite proiecte care țin capetele de afiș ale presei de tehnologie din toată lumea.

programme.title: Insider politic
programme.desc: Un talk-show politic şi nu numai, care va aborda cele mai importante evenimente din actualitatea românească, cu două puncte de vedere asupra temei săptămânii, cel al invitatului dar şi al realizatorului.

programme.title: Life & Style cu Maria Andrei
programme.desc: Emisiunea le propune telespectatorilor să redescopere destinații bine cunoscute, dar și rute alternative, să cunoască oameni deosebiți și să le afle poveștile, rețetele gastronomice și produsele locale premiate. Maria Andrei mai aduce în atenția publicului știri pertinente și autentice cu ajutorul unor specialiști respectați, și îi ajută să fie la curent cu ultimele tendințe în domeniul life & style.

programme.title: Răpirea fecioarelor
programme.desc: La inceputul secolului al XIX-lea, printr-o tacita intelegere cu doamna Haricleea (Olga Tudorache), care doreste sa-si indeparteze sotul de la tron, bandele lui Pazvanoglu (George Constantin), pasa de Vidin, ataca fara mila satele, rapind fete. Haricleea isi trimite fiul la adapost, la o manastire, dar haiducii lui Amza (Emanoil Petrut) il rapesc, pentru a-l da in schimbul incetarii jafurilor. In timp ce haiducii urmaresc un boier, care vrea sa fuga din tara cu averea, Pazvanoglu ataca din nou. La… citeşte.

programme.title: Schimb de mame
programme.desc: Emisiunea "Schimb de mame" aduce în prim plan experienţele inedite trăite de soțiile-mame care au curajul să își schimbe viaţa pentru șapte zile. În fiecare săptămînă, două soții-mame vor face "schimb de vieți", vor avea o familie, prieteni și o slujbă complet noi, într-o localitate și o casa cu totul necunoscute. La final, protagoniștii se vor întâlni pentru a-și împărtăși experienţele trăite în răstimpul celor șapte zile și vor fi premiați.

programme.title: Focus 18
programme.desc: La Focus 18, cel mai important jurnal de stiri, telespectatorii pot urmări, in fiecare zi, atât materiale în exclusivitate, cât şi rubrici dedicate sau reportaje speciale.

programme.title: La limita extremă
Point Break
programme.desc: LA LIMITA EXTREMĂ este un thriller de acțiune plin de adrenalină, producție a companiei Alcon Entertainment, în care un tânăr agent FBI, Johnny Utah (Luke Bracey), se infiltrează într-un grup de sportivi de elită mereu în căutarea de senzații tari, condus de charismaticul Bodhi (Edgar Ramirez), pentru a investiga dacă suspiciunile legate de implicarea acestora într-o serie de infracțiuni executate în manieră extremă și neobișnuită sunt reale. Aflat sub acoperire, cu viața mereu în pericol iminent, Utah e… citeşte.

programme.title: Cronica cârcotaşilor
programme.desc: Emisiunea Cronica cârcotaşilor prezintă o variantă unică a celor mai importante noutăţi din domeniul politic, social, cultural sau economic. Telespectatorii vor mai afla şi cum stau românii la capitolul cultură generală prin rubrica “Vocea Poporului”, iar “Top Ruşinică” face clasamentul binecunoscut al gafelor din televiziuni.

programme.title: Drumul rușinii
Walk of Shame
programme.desc: Ca să se consoleze după un pas înapoi în carieră, Meghan, o prezentatoare de știri din Los Angeles, se aruncă într-o noapte de benchetuială. Dimineață se trezește în patul unui necunoscut și intră în panică atunci când un mesaj lăsat pe telefon o anunță că este dorită pentru un post mult-visat! Aflată într-o zonă necunoscută, fără bani sau mașină și cu telefonul descărcat, Meghan va trebui să dea dovadă de o imensă inventivitate pentru a ajunge tocmai în cealaltă parte… citeşte.

programme.title: Poezie și delicatețuri
programme.desc: Un show în care ingredientele culinare sunt omniprezente iar sarea și piperul sunt adăugate de confesiunile invitaților. Poezie şi delicateţuri oferă o bună ocazie telespectatorului să intre într-o lume în care poezia este în orice, de la un pahar de vin până la povestea de viaţă a invitaţilor, iar bucătăria tradiţională este la ea acasă.

programme.title: Flash monden
programme.desc: Emisiunea îți prezintă subiecte la zi, informații și imagini de ultim moment, dar și povești în premieră, despre celebritățile autohtone și internaționale. Specialiștii emisiunii comentează ținutele vedetelor iar astrologul de serviciu îți spune ce îți rezervă astrele pentru fiecare zi din săptămână.

programme.title: Life & Style cu Maria Andrei
programme.desc: Emisiunea le propune telespectatorilor să redescopere destinații bine cunoscute, dar și rute alternative, să cunoască oameni deosebiți și să le afle poveștile, rețetele gastronomice și produsele locale premiate. Maria Andrei mai aduce în atenția publicului știri pertinente și autentice cu ajutorul unor specialiști respectați, și îi ajută să fie la curent cu ultimele tendințe în domeniul life & style.

programme.title: Focus
programme.desc: Emisiunea Focus este setată pe ştiri relevante pentru fiecare, pe informaţia esenţială, corectă şi obiectivă, pe poveşti şi fapte generatoare de plus-valoare în societate.

programme.title: Sănătate cu stil
programme.desc: Prezentatoarea emisiunii aduce în atenţia telespectatorilor o serie întreagă de afecţiuni, cu care se confruntă tot mai mulţi români, şi oferă cele mai bune soluţii şi remedii pentru acestea, cu ajutorul celor mai buni medici din România. Telespectatorii vor afla şi cum pot avea grija cel mai bine de sănătatea lor, cum se pot hrăni sănătos, ce beneficii aduce mişcarea în viaţa lor, cum pot trata cel mai bine afecţiuni de care le este teamă sau ruşine să vorbească, dar şi cum îşi pot asigura o stare de bine cu ajutorul leacurilor din natură, al plantelor care pot face adevărate miracole pentru sănătatea lor.

programme.title: Connect
programme.desc: Emisiunea Connect își propune să prezinte săptămânal cele mai noi și interesante gadgeturi, de la cele mai cunoscute telefoane, laptopuri, wearables, aplicații și jocuri, la cele mai inedite proiecte care țin capetele de afiș ale presei de tehnologie din toată lumea.

programme.title: Insider politic
programme.desc: Un talk-show politic şi nu numai, care va aborda cele mai importante evenimente din actualitatea românească, cu două puncte de vedere asupra temei săptămânii, cel al invitatului dar şi al realizatorului.

programme.title: Răpirea fecioarelor
programme.desc: La inceputul secolului al XIX-lea, printr-o tacita intelegere cu doamna Haricleea (Olga Tudorache), care doreste sa-si indeparteze sotul de la tron, bandele lui Pazvanoglu (George Constantin), pasa de Vidin, ataca fara mila satele, rapind fete. Haricleea isi trimite fiul la adapost, la o manastire, dar haiducii lui Amza (Emanoil Petrut) il rapesc, pentru a-l da in schimbul incetarii jafurilor. In timp ce haiducii urmaresc un boier, care vrea sa fuga din tara cu averea, Pazvanoglu ataca din nou. La… citeşte.

programme.title: Mama
Ma-ma
programme.desc: Lupul si banda sa rapesc iezii Caprei, pretinzandu-i o rascumparare substantiala.Ecranizare a povestirii "Capra cu trei iezi" de Ion Creanga. Singurul film romanesc realizat in trei versiuni (romana, rusa, engleza) si partial in franceza."Mama este intr-adevar un spectacol fastuos, de o vitalitate usor naucitoare, dar calculat cu bagare de seama din scenariu, din regie, din imagine cat si cum sa fie fastuos, cat si cum sa fie naucitor". - Eva Sarbu - 1977 (Cinema).

programme.title: Cronica cârcotaşilor
programme.desc: Emisiunea Cronica cârcotaşilor prezintă o variantă unică a celor mai importante noutăţi din domeniul politic, social, cultural sau economic. Telespectatorii vor mai afla şi cum stau românii la capitolul cultură generală prin rubrica “Vocea Poporului”, iar “Top Ruşinică” face clasamentul binecunoscut al gafelor din televiziuni.

programme.title: Focus 18
programme.desc: La Focus 18, cel mai important jurnal de stiri, telespectatorii pot urmări, in fiecare zi, atât materiale în exclusivitate, cât şi rubrici dedicate sau reportaje speciale.

programme.title: Secretele președintelui
programme.desc: Acest film nu are sinopsis.

programme.title: Schimb de mame
programme.desc: Emisiunea "Schimb de mame" aduce în prim plan experienţele inedite trăite de soțiile-mame care au curajul să își schimbe viaţa pentru șapte zile. În fiecare săptămînă, două soții-mame vor face "schimb de vieți", vor avea o familie, prieteni și o slujbă complet noi, într-o localitate și o casa cu totul necunoscute. La final, protagoniștii se vor întâlni pentru a-și împărtăși experienţele trăite în răstimpul celor șapte zile și vor fi premiați.

programme.title: Secretele președintelui
programme.desc: Acest film nu are sinopsis.

Un format dinamic, rapid şi captivant, 50:50 aduce în prim-plan doi concurenţi care se confruntă într-o competiţie unde fiecare întrebare contează, iar şansele de câştig sunt mereu egale: 50% – 50%. Tot jocul se învârte în jurul numărului 50.

programme.title: Gata oricând! - Eroii de la Podul Jiului
programme.desc: În dimineața zilei de 14 octombrie 1916, când un tânăr cercetaș descoperă că temuta armată germană a ajuns nestingherită aproape de Târgu-Jiu, îl anunță în grabă pe comisarul orașului Ioan Popilian și, împreună cu câțiva polițiști și cercetași, ajutați de câțiva civili rămași în orașul deja evacuat, luptă la Podul Jiului pentru a opri ocuparea orașului de inamic până la sosirea armatei române. Ocuparea podului ar fi dus la ocuparea gării, lucru ce ar fi permis armatei germane să oprească… citeşte.

programme.title: Cursa iubirii
programme.desc: 12 cupluri intră în aventură, dar aventura le va demonstra dacă sunt cu adevărat un cuplu. Pot face față provocărilor? Se pot susține unul pe altul în momente de tensiune maximă? Nervii vor ceda ușor, lacrimile vor curge, competiția va atinge cote nebănuite și va genera situații la limită.

programme.title: Exclusiv VIP
programme.desc: Lumea mondenă îşi deschide larg uşile şi îi invită în culisele ei pe telespectatorii Prima TV. Moderatorul emisiunii este pregătit să îi descoasă pe invitaţi şi să le afle toate secretele. Exclusivităţi, momente emoţionante, discuţii între prieteni, voie bună şi relaxare!

programme.title: Iubiri vinovate
Perdona Nuestros Pecados
programme.desc: La începutul anilor ´50, Maria, fiica unei familii puternice din înalta aristocraţie chiliană se îndrăgosteşte, nepermis, de fiul unei servitoare! Preotul Reynaldo Suarez, nou venit în localitate, se îndrăgosteşte, la rândul său, de Maria! Pe cine să aleagă el? Credinţa sau iubirea? În această lume închistată în reguli şi prejudecăţi, dragostea, e singurul sentiment care circulă liber printre oameni şi care dărâmă prejudecăţi, provocând însă drame şi suferinţe.

programme.title: Coliziunea
Collide
programme.desc: Aflat în Germania, Casey, un tânăr excursionist american, se îndrăgosteşte de Juliette, o colegă împreună cu care călătoreşte prin Europa. Când ea este diagnosticată cu o boală incurabilă, Casey se hotărăşte să-l prade pe un gangster german, Hagen, pentru a face rost de banii pentru tratamentul care i-ar putea salva viaţa lui Juliette. Planul lui Casey nu reuşeşte însă, pentru că Hagen află şi îl prinde. În ciuda tuturor obstacolelor, Casey reuşeşte să scape din… citeşte.

programme.title: La limita extremă
Point Break
programme.desc: LA LIMITA EXTREMĂ este un thriller de acțiune plin de adrenalină, producție a companiei Alcon Entertainment, în care un tânăr agent FBI, Johnny Utah (Luke Bracey), se infiltrează într-un grup de sportivi de elită mereu în căutarea de senzații tari, condus de charismaticul Bodhi (Edgar Ramirez), pentru a investiga dacă suspiciunile legate de implicarea acestora într-o serie de infracțiuni executate în manieră extremă și neobișnuită sunt reale. Aflat sub acoperire, cu viața mereu în pericol iminent, Utah e… citeşte.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Ancient Aliens menghitung mundur sepuluh misteri teratas di laut, mulai dari benua yang tenggelam, reruntuhan nan mencurigakan di dasar laut, hingga sejumlah artefak yang mungkin merupakan sisa-sisa kota Atlantis.

programme.title: Mysteries Unearthed
programme.desc: Jelajahi sejumlah rahasia yang tersembunyi di beberapa terowongan, gua, atau bahkan situs pemakaman, seperti harta karun yang ditemukan di dalam kota yang hilang hingga manuskrip kuno yang tersembunyi di balik tembok.

programme.title: Lost U-Boats Of WW2
programme.desc: Pemburu harta karun Darrell Miklos dan timnya menemukan sesuatu yang jauh lebih tua dari yang mereka duga. Lalu, bukti mengungkapkan bahwa tim mungkin menemukan jejak pertempuran yang telah lama hilang di Target 4.

programme.title: Greatest Mysteries
programme.desc: Meski telah terjadi penampakan dan pencarian selama berabad-abad, salah satu monster laut ini masih belum teridentifikasi. Seiring bertambahnya bukti, misteri terus berlanjut, apakah Monster Loch Ness benar-benar ada?

programme.title: Skinwalker Ranch
programme.desc: Usai menemukan bukti baru tentang sejumlah benda logam yang terkubur di bawah Mesa, tim melakukan sebuah eksperimen di Area Segitiga yang mengarah pada salah satu bukti paling mengejutkan di Peternakan Skinwalker.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Tim Ancient Aliens menghitung mundur sepuluh simbol dan kode paling menarik serta misterius yang ditemukan di seluruh dunia yang mungkin berisi bukti kontak dengan dunia lain.

programme.title: Swamp People: Serpent
programme.desc: Raja Rawa Troy Landry mengajari rekannya yang sudah lama berburu buaya, Pickle Wheat, tentang seluk beluk perburuan ular piton. Namun terkadang, pemburu yang paling berpengalaman pun pulang dengan bekas luka.

programme.title: Lost U-Boats Of WW2
programme.desc: Pemburu harta karun Darrell Miklos dan timnya menemukan sesuatu yang jauh lebih tua dari yang mereka duga. Lalu, bukti mengungkapkan bahwa tim mungkin menemukan jejak pertempuran yang telah lama hilang di Target 4.

programme.title: Kutukan Arwah Santet
programme.desc: Sebuah misteri tentang sepasang kekasih yang tak dapat dipisahkan usai bercinta membuat Tya penasaran. Selain itu, setiap ada kematian, Kirana selalu terlihat di lokasi dan tampak kebingungan.

programme.title: Hantu Budeg
programme.desc: Magda, Inge, Royce dan Bram meminta Kojek untuk mentraktir mereka liburan. Di tengah kegembiraan mereka, Magda mendapati bahwa terdapat beberapa penampakan di foto-foto yang ia ambil.

programme.title: Dia Yang Tercinta
programme.desc: Harliman sangat terpukul saat kekasihnya, Lestari, menikah dengan Rachmat. Ia pun berusaha bangkit dengan bekerja di Kalimantan. Namun kemudian, ia nekat bekerja pada Rachmat demi merebut Lestari.

programme.title: Lutung Kasarung
programme.desc: Guruminda dikutuk oleh sang ibu menjadi Lutung Kasarung karena menginginkan seorang istri yang secantik ibunya. Kutukan tersebut akan hilang jika ada wanita yang mencintainya.

programme.title: Kuntilanak
programme.desc: Lima remaja menemukan sebuah cermin antik di panti asuhan mereka. Cermin itu dihuni oleh sesosok hantu jahat yang menculik anak-anak dan mengurung mereka di dalam cermin tersebut.

programme.title: Maju Kena Mundur Kena...
programme.desc: Tiga sahabat ditantang untuk masuk ke sebuah asrama yang berisi gadis-gadis nan cantik di dekat tempat kerja mereka. Mereka pun berpura-pura menjadi impoten dan buta agar dapat masuk ke sana.

programme.title: Suami-Suami Takut Istri
programme.desc: Para istri di Griya Mintari beserta suami mereka berwisata ke Bali untuk menghadiri pertunjukan Trio Ganas. Berbagai peristiwa lucu pun terjadi saat para suami mencari akal agar dapat berkencan dengan para penyanyi.

programme.title: Ratu Kostmopolitan
programme.desc: Tiga wanita yang tinggal di sebuah rumah kos di Jakarta harus berurusan dengan sekelompok preman yang ingin mengusir ketiganya dari tempat tinggal mereka nan sederhana.

programme.title: Soekarno
programme.desc: Mengikuti kehidupan Soekarno, presiden pertama Republik Indonesia, dari masa kecilnya hingga ia berhasil memproklamasikan kemerdekaan Indonesia bersama M. Hatta pada tahun 1945.

programme.title: Jin & Jun
programme.desc: Setelah dihajar oleh para perundung, seorang siswa SMA yang merasa putus asa bertemu dengan sesosok jin yang dapat memperbaiki keberuntungannya, sekaligus menjadikannya kaya.

programme.title: Bing Slamet Sibuk
programme.desc: Terinspirasi dari film The Sound Of Music, film ini menceritakan Bing Slamet yang bekerja di keluarga Eddy Sud yang memiliki banyak anak. Anak-anak menyukainya karena ia pandai bernyanyi.

programme.title: Hattrick
programme.desc: Sebuah tim sepak bola dengan segala perbedaan dan permasalahan ego harus memenangkan turnamen sepak bola Internasional untuk bertahan hidup.
Setelah menikah, Kevin dan Nayla menempati sebuah rumah baru yang serba otomatis. Namun, Nayla selalu merasa ada yang mengawasi, mendekat, bahkan menyentuhnya di rumah tersebut.

programme.title: Bangkit Dari Lumpur
programme.desc: Suatu hari, Shakira menyaksikan sebuah pembunuhan di ruang bawah tanah sang kekasih. Kemudian, ia dibunuh dan jasadnya dibuang ke lumpur Lapindo untuk menghindari kecurigaan.

programme.title: Pantai Selatan
programme.desc: Lastri yang tengah hamil melarikan diri dari rumah karena orang tuanya memaksanya untuk menikah. Ia pun bersembunyi di dalam Gua Blorong dan menolak kembali ke rumah dengan memilih untuk melompat dari atas tebing.

programme.title: Semua Karena Ginah
programme.desc: Ginah adalah wanita yang menarik meski ia hanya seorang penjual jamu. Keanggunan dan keramahannya membuat banyak orang menyukainya.

programme.title: Rumah Bekas Kuburan
programme.desc: Larasati tak sengaja terbunuh saat Karina ketahuan selingkuh dengan Danu, suaminya. Akibat peristiwa tersebut, Kirana harus memberikan tumbal untuk arwah Larasati.

programme.title: Sunan Kalijaga
programme.desc: Film ini menceritakan perjalanan R.M. Said dalam menjadi Sunan Kalijaga, salah satu dari sembilan Sunan yang dikenal dengan Wali Songo.

programme.title: Abdullah Dan Takeshi
programme.desc: Sebuah kisah tentang dua anak laki-laki yang tertukar saat lahir di sebuah rumah sakit di Jepang. Bayi keturunan Arab dibesarkan oleh keluarga Jepang, sedangkan bayi keturunan Jepang dibesarkan oleh keluarga Arab.

programme.title: Hantu Juga Selfie
programme.desc: Setelah euforia kelulusan sekolah, Loly, Vega, Gea dan Jean pergi berlibur ke sebuah pulau. Di sana, mereka diteror oleh Helsi dan hantu-hantu lucu lainnya lewat swafoto.

programme.title: Blok M
programme.desc: Film ini menceritakan kisah persahabatan Lola dan Cindy yang kerap berkumpul di Blok M untuk menceritakan problematika hidup mereka masing-masing.

programme.title: Cewek Gokil
programme.desc: Keke bekerja dengan giat agar dapat memiliki Mini Cooper, mobil impiannya. Namun, semua usahanya semakin menjauhkan dirinya dari orang-orang yang ia sayangi.

programme.title: Selamanya
programme.desc: Bara berjuang untuk menyelamatkan Aristha dari jeratan narkoba dan prostitusi. Ia juga menyelamatkan Aristha yang ingin bunuh diri. Namun, semua berakhir tragis saat Aristha yang tengah sakit meninggal di pelukan Bara.

programme.title: Pesan Dari Surga
programme.desc: Lima pemuda bergabung dalam grup musik bernama Topeng. Suatu saat, terjadi masalah besar dan band ini terancam bubar. Namun, seorang korban kecelakaan yang tersadar dari koma datang dan membawa pesan dari surga.

programme.title: Kirun+Adul Pengen Punya...
programme.desc: Seorang putri wakil presiden, Gita, memanfaatkan dua pria, Kirun dan Adul, demi melampiaskan rasa kesalnya pada sang ayah. Akibatnya, dua pria tersebut menjadi tertuduh pelaku penculikan Gita.

programme.title: Love You Love You Not
programme.desc: Sebuah film komedi romantis tentang Amira yang mengajar bahasa Inggris kepada seorang pria Betawi yang pemarah bernama Juki agar dapat menyusul kekasihnya ke Amerika.

programme.title: Gentayangan
programme.desc: Usai dinyatakan bangkrut oleh pengadilan, Abimanyu Karindra terpaksa mengajak istri, kedua anak, serta adiknya yang bernama Sheila untuk tinggal di hotel peninggalan orang tua di sebuah lembah gunung.

programme.title: Ateng Kaya Mendadak
programme.desc: Dua petani bernama Ateng dan Iskak memenangkan sebuah undian yang membuat mereka menjadi jutawan dalam sekejap. Keduanya pun pergi ke Jakarta dan bertemu dengan Vivi, putri seorang CEO hotel bernama Eddy Sud.

programme.title: Pokun Roxy
programme.desc: Acong, Bedul, dan Jupe, menyusun sebuah rencana untuk mengambil keuntungan dari kasus Pokun Roxy. Mereka menyebarkan desas-desus dengan menyatakan bahwa mereka dapat memotret dua hantu tersebut menggunakan ponsel.

programme.title: Cintaku Di Rumah Susun
programme.desc: Sebuah film yang menggambarkan tentang kehidupan di suatu apartemen nan sederhana.

programme.title: Arie Hanggara
programme.desc: Film ini diangkat dari kisah nyata seorang anak yang menjadi korban kekerasan di Jakarta pada tahun 1984.

programme.title: Marina
programme.desc: Anton SH, seorang pengacara muda, menikahi Marina dan memintanya untuk tidak hamil. Kehidupan pernikahan mereka berantakan saat Marina sukses menjadi seorang penyanyi dan karier Anton hancur.

programme.title: Jin & Jun
programme.desc: Setelah dihajar oleh para perundung, seorang siswa SMA yang merasa putus asa bertemu dengan sesosok jin yang dapat memperbaiki keberuntungannya, sekaligus menjadikannya kaya.

玉堂春 / The Story of Sue San
programme.desc: 王金龍與名妓蘇三相愛，無奈無錢被趕出富春院。蘇被老鴇賣予富戶沈燕林為妾，卻被沈妻誣告毒殺親夫，判以死罪。已考取功名的王，決意開堂覆審救蘇...

programme.title: 武林聖火令 / Holy Flame of the Martial World
programme.desc: 尹天仇的父母因一對武林聖火令﻿遭人暗算身亡，他和妹妹分別被忠奸兩派收養撫育，兄妹各持一半聖火令，習得絕世武功。起初兩人勢同水火，卻在揭開身世秘密後攜手合作，共同為父母報仇雪恨。.

programme.title: 人蛇鼠 / Fangs of the Cobra
programme.desc: 莊家農場獨子莊士德海外歸來，接手由胡麟管理的產業。胡一直與德之表妹曼玲勾結，圖取莊家產業，並欲利用曼玲美色迷惑德！怎知在阿芬飼養的小蛇「西西」幫助下，反令德與芬結成夫婦。後來胡買來一條專咬人的野老鼠，欲將德之初生嬰兒咬死，「西西」為救嬰兒，與野鼠作殊死搏鬥...

programme.title: 烏龍濟公 / The Mad Monk Strikes Again
programme.desc: 濟公與修道成仙的呂洞賓鬥智鬥法，二人使出渾身解數，不論是笑聲、法力、風流韻事，甚至乎兵器，雙方都不惜一切對決到底！.

programme.title: 紅粉動江湖 / Ambitious Kung Fu Girl
programme.desc: 富家女田思思性格刁蠻任性，略通武藝。自從聽聞武林名俠秦歌﻿蓋世無雙的英勇事跡後，心生仰慕。她拒絕順從父親的婚姻安排，女扮男裝，私自出走尋找秦歌﻿，欲向他挑戰。豈料，途中卻誤入黑道陰謀的漩渦…….

programme.title: 椰林春戀 / Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: 富商之子平建人由於不願繼承父業，決定跟女朋友蘇詠蘭自開旅行社，招攬女教師董嫻芸和四個少女學生遊覽馬來西亞。詠蘭在旅途中眼看女學生李愛蓉癡戀建人，又誤會建人與嫻芸相戀，傷心失望離去。後來發現嫻芸早有情人梁茂夫，一場誤會始告冰釋。愛蓉得悉建人將與詠蘭結婚，精神失常，駕車撞山受傷昏迷…….

programme.title: 金衣大俠 / The Golden Knight
programme.desc: 故事講述女俠俞飛霞，被武林盟主誤會她是运用「黑沙掌」，偷去神功寶書的幪面少女。於是她女扮男裝，混入少林寺暗中查探真相...

programme.title: 我們戀愛去了 / Let's Fall In Love
programme.desc: 一次偶然機會下，富家子大用巧遇育幼院院長之外甥女連蓮。二人初次見面，雙方即發生誤會，大用更在匆忙間遺下皮包。當大用硬將連蓮假裝成爲自己的未婚妻好讓兩個傾慕他的女子死心時，又與連蓮發生了第二次誤會...

programme.title: 盜皇陵 / The Imperial Tomb Raiders
programme.desc: 一個身手不凡的獨行客與一隊英姿颯爽的娘子軍，合力對抗一羣張牙舞爪的土匪，成功阻止皇帝的陵墓被盜。.

programme.title: 故都春夢 / Between Tears and Smiles
programme.desc: 故事源自膾炙人口的《啼笑因緣》，內容描述民國初年，富家子范嘉恕戀上歌女岑逢仙，同時又唯賣藝少女官繡珠及貌似岑的財政廳長女兒賀莉霞所迷戀。張大帥垂涎岑，更姦污了她。嘉恕後得繡珠相助，才從大帥手中救回愛人。.

programme.title: 虎胆 / Raw Courage
programme.desc: 明惠帝被篡位後，太子被藏匿在武林義士的黑龍會中，卻被武林敗類所襲擊，迫使入世未深的劍客及俠女帶著太子逃亡。他們一路上危機重重，幸得其他義士拔刀相助…….

programme.title: 鬼屋麗人 / The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: 本片是根據《聊齋》中之《書癡》改編，故事描述玉柱被叔叔郎中元欺負，搬進常鬧鬼的「孝廉府」。然後玉柱遇上了顏如玉，二人及後結成夫婦。郎中元之友史良金竟拐走如玉，將其迷奸。良金妻妾更毒害如玉，如玉化成厲鬼，將中元、良金等人殺害。玉柱因如玉已不在人世，不禁一陣辛酸。.

programme.title: 獨臂刀 / One-armed Swordsman
programme.desc: 方剛的父親為救神風大俠齊如峰而死，齊如峰感念救命之恩，收留方剛入金刀門。方剛卻飽受師兄等人的歧視，於是決定遠走他鄉。齊如峰的獨女與方剛決戰時，竟用刀斬斷其右臂，方剛卻因此練成獨臂刀法，最終更挺身而出救助齊如峰。.

programme.title: 鳳還巢 / Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: 兵部侍郎程浦將次女雪娥許配予好友之子穆居易，庶室程夫人既憤且惱，對居易訛稱長女雪雁乃雪娥，催促二人早日成親。居易見雪雁貌醜而癡，嚇得留書出走。富豪朱煥然對雪娥心儀已久，趁此良機冒充居易，依期迎親……本片由李香君、金峰分飾男、女主角，配搭新鮮；而蔣光超與莊元庸一胖一瘦的諧趣演出，更令人笑破肚皮。.

programme.title: 鳳還巢 / Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: 兵部侍郎程浦將次女雪娥許配予好友之子穆居易，庶室程夫人既憤且惱，對居易訛稱長女雪雁乃雪娥，催促二人早日成親。居易見雪雁貌醜而癡，嚇得留書出走。富豪朱煥然對雪娥心儀已久，趁此良機冒充居易，依期迎親……本片由李香君、金峰分飾男、女主角，配搭新鮮；而蔣光超與莊元庸一胖一瘦的諧趣演出，更令人笑破肚皮。.

programme.title: 浣花洗劍 / The Spirit of the Sword
programme.desc: 太湖決戰前夕，白水宮主人被東瀛劍客所傷。於是，他囑咐其弟寶玉代尋找解藥。途中寶玉偶遇關外的小公主，二人一見鍾情。但原來小公主的背後卻隱藏著一個重大陰謀….

programme.title: 銷魂玉 / Return Of The Dead
programme.desc: 王致和無意得到通靈玩意，許下三個願望，雖然願望靈驗之極，結果落得家散人亡；風塵女孟薇被情人林坤全害死，變成水鬼復仇；豔麗女子蕭雲玉香消玉殞後，仍不斷在人間走動，盜墳贼欲挖開蕭雲玉墳墓盜取陪葬珠寶，終被蕭雲玉追殺致死...

programme.title: 蘭嶼之歌 / Song Of Orchid Island
programme.desc: 蘭嶼紅蟲為患，島上人只信大頭目及巫醫巴達兩人。年青醫生何維德到蘭嶼找尋曾到此研究紅蟲而失蹤的父親，因而與未婚妻白丹娜鬧翻。後來何與孤女雅蘭相愛，惹來西呼達嫉妒；同時何為島民治病，令巴達信眾日減，西呼達、巴達均伺機殺何，何身陷險境而不自知…….

programme.title: 掌門人 / The Lady is the Boss
programme.desc: 為「功夫大導」劉家良於1983年自編自導自演的作品。故事描述，劉代師傅主持國術會，一向平安無事，適逢會館搬遷，劉派女兒惠英紅接掌；新舊派作風回異，劉只得離去；後因惠頻惹是非，劉聞訊即回巢聲援….

programme.title: 江湖子弟 / Brotherhood
programme.desc: 本片改編自七十年代知名小說家江之南的作品。故事描述，劉永被掠去財物，為生計打劫，開罪了歐陽幫，但幫主欣賞劉膽色，交上朋友來，後保鏢李麗麗對劉有好感，卻惹黑旗門胡妒忌….

programme.title: 大地兒女 / Sons Of Good Earth
programme.desc: 這是一部經典戰爭鉅片，描述抗日戰爭時人民的生活狀況。畫家俞瑞意外救了由鄉下被拐賣來的女子荷花。兩人互生情愫，不久更結為夫妻過著幸福的日子。無奈好景不常，不久日軍全面侵入中國，亦正式展開殘酷的統治….

programme.title: 少年蘇乞兒 / Young Vagabond
programme.desc: 蘇燦為蘇家酒莊主人蘇瑞之長子，生性恬淡隨和，但喜酗酒及流連妓院，令老父深感不滿。一日，燦在學校與同學打架，被逐出校，被逼追隨墊師梁鴻讀書。燦在偶然機會下發現梁鴻身懷絕技，央其收之為徒。後蘇家遭北方劇盜蜈蚣滅門，梁鴻亦死於蜈蚣暗算之下，燦為著公仇私恨，與蜈蚣展開一場生死決...

programme.title: 茅山殭屍拳 / The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: 以「趕屍」為業的陳師父與徒弟受託押運九具殭屍，啟程上路。未料途中兩具竟逃脫。其中一具實際上並非殭屍，而是為躲避敵人追殺而假扮的江湖豪客。更令人意外的是，此人與陳師父同樣身懷絕技，二人皆為深不可測的武林高手！.

programme.title: 滿天神佛 / Ghosts Galore
programme.desc: 一次驅鬼時，青年術士魯興與友人因功力太差被女鬼戲弄險告喪命，幸得連大師施法幫助，才將女鬼驅逐。於是二人馬上拜他為師。友人意外地被日本忍者所殺，魯興決定要學習絕世茅術，與大師一起對付殘暴的忍者，因而引發終極亂鬥！.

programme.title: 萬花迎春 / The Dancing Millionairess
programme.desc: 歌舞團台柱陳君邁賦閒多時後，應徵當富家女梅倩如的司機，竟被誤傳戀情。倩如為查明流言的來源，假扮記者採訪歌舞團，期間君邁與倩如暗生好感，經過一番試探後，二人終一舞定情。.

programme.title: 五毒天羅 / The Web of Death
programme.desc: 《五毒天羅》是武林至毒之物，不知收藏何方。五毒教的蛇壇主，要找出天羅所在，獨霸武林，誤放消息，謂天羅已重現武林，江湖一片風聲鶴唳….

programme.title: 神經大俠 / Lovers Blades
programme.desc: 威力無敵的兵器鴛鴦刀將要送給滿清的皇帝，卻不慎落入蕭中慧和袁冠南手裏。大內高手卓天雄於是出發追捕二人，誓要取回鴛鴦刀。大戰一觸即發，此刻鴛鴦刀的秘密也同被揭開。.

programme.title: 大醉俠 / Come Drink with Me
programme.desc: 女俠「金燕子」的兄長被山贼擄走，幸得武功高強的「醉俠」范大悲相助，從作惡多端的寺廟主持手上救出兄長。本片曾代表香港出戰第39屆奧斯卡金像獎最佳外語片的首輪評選。.

programme.title: 雙鐲 / The Twin Bracelets
programme.desc: 兩名少女作盟誓要在一個沒有女權，甚或缺乏性自由的小漁村互相照顧一生。一位最終下嫁自己不認識的人，之後過著幸福快樂的日子。而另一位少女則慘遭許配給虐待成性的富家子，於是她唯有設法擺脫這個困境。.

programme.title: 雙鐲 / The Twin Bracelets
programme.desc: 兩名少女作盟誓要在一個沒有女權，甚或缺乏性自由的小漁村互相照顧一生。一位最終下嫁自己不認識的人，之後過著幸福快樂的日子。而另一位少女則慘遭許配給虐待成性的富家子，於是她唯有設法擺脫這個困境。.

programme.title: 魔殿屠龍 / The Hidden Power Of Dragon Sabre
programme.desc: 本片算是金庸《倚天屠龍記》之外傳。由爾冬升飾張無忌、狄龍飾蒙古戰士、萬梓良飾宋青書及鍾楚紅飾蒙古公主。故事講述張無忌取回倚天劍、屠龍刀，供放在明教總壇，並將九陽神功秘笈刻於三重峰密室之中，由已皈依佛門的金毛獅王監守，原經交回少林...

programme.title: 風花雪月 / Moods Of Love
programme.desc: 本片由兩個單元故事組成。首個故事講述柳宣教策劃了一個破玉通禪師「色戒」之奇計，著美豔妓女紅蓮向玉通大施色誘攻勢。第二個故事講述少女馮玉華之母馮孫氏欠下九尾狐一筆錢無法償還，被逼做妓女還債。後馮孫氏因性病死去，遺下一筆債務以及殮葬費須玉華償還；玉華無奈，只好踏上母親所走過之路...

programme.title: 鑽石艷盜 / The Venus' Tear Diamond
programme.desc: 兩大珠寶盜賊「夜來香」和「夜爵士」前往日本，意圖偷去「維納斯的眼淚」巨鑽。二人見面後即墜入愛河，卻不知道原來對方同為盜取巨鑽的競敵。最後誰會得到巨鑽？二人的戀情又會否無疾而終？.

programme.title: 老夫子奇趣錄 / Mr. Funnybone Strikes Again
programme.desc: 電影承上集繼續笑料百出。這次，大蕃薯開了一家中醫診所，但傳統的中醫似乎不為時髦的香港社會接受。最後得靠好友老夫子相助，為他解決疑難！.

programme.title: 鐵旗門 / The Flag of Iron
programme.desc: 正派「鐵旗門」與反派「神鷹堂」，一直對立。一次，「神鷹堂」堂主以向「鐵旗門」陪罪為辭，邀「鐵旗門」門主鐵麟偕弟子往總壇喝酒；鐵認為內中有詐，不宜前往，但大弟子曹風則力言將計就計，若彼等有所行動，就乘機將他們消滅，鐵允之。「神鷹堂」果然十面埋伏，鐵等將敵人逐一殲滅；惟鐵竟在混亂中遇害，卻未知死於誰手….

programme.title: 青春鼓王 / King Drummer
programme.desc: 船員孫志强巧合成爲「火花大樂隊」的鼓手，他因急于成名，答應幫助音樂雜志出版人李源明接近樂隊經理黃麗真，以換取源明的力捧。終于，志强得償所願，一炮而紅，源明却逼他實踐諾言，與麗真斷絕來往。志强受到極大打擊，唯有忍痛離開樂隊與麗真...

programme.title: 金印仇 / The Golden Seal
programme.desc: 戴天仇自幼習武，矢志為父報仇。彼時其殺父仇人，到處為非作歹。戴上路途中遇上女扮男裝的吳小燕，並突遭多名幫會中人毒打，吳遂求父允其把戴帶返家中養傷。戴竟因此得以混入仇人地盤，希望可乘機報仇...

programme.title: 徐老虎與白寡婦 / The Tiger and the Widow
programme.desc: 本片改編自高陽同名著作，獲第18屆金馬獎最佳服裝設計、最佳美術設計兩項獎。本片講述清朝食鹽私梟徐老虎與白寡婦因清官李振彪拒不受賄，再加上責令嚴緝私鹽，二人面臨緝案危機。為免同僚落網，白獨擔罪責。徐悉白被處死，一心復仇….

programme.title: 隱身女俠 / Shadow Girl
programme.desc: 年輕女劍客服下奶奶研製的隱身藥後，變成白天隱形晚上現身的怪人。她無意中搗亂了黑道首領女兒的婚事，惹來連番追殺。女劍客最後如何脫險？.

programme.title: 花木蘭 / Lady General Hua Mu-Lan
programme.desc: 花木蘭因父親年事已高，毅然女扮男裝替父從軍，對戰匈奴。她英勇善戰，屢立奇功，更被擢升為大將軍。木蘭衣錦還鄉，為家族贏得了無上的榮光。元帥欲將女兒許配給她的時候，才得知她是女兒身。.

programme.title: 鬼馬兩金剛 / Crazy Nuts Of Kung Fu
programme.desc: 一名強盜和一位居無定所的賭徒合作以賭賺錢。一天，他們成功從叛國軍閥屋裡偷取一大筆金錢，途中卻遇上革命戰士，並希望他們能資助革命叛軍計劃。二人是否會用偷來的財富協助革命戰士？.

programme.title: 七仙女 / A Maid From Heaven
programme.desc: 故事描述少年董永賣身傳員外家，為奴以埋父骨；其孝心感動了七仙女，便幻成村姑，在六位仙姐下凡暗助下，為董縮減償還工作日，回復自由後，二人回董故家，但愉快的凡間生活能持續多久呢？.

programme.title: 獨臂刀王 / Return of the One-armed Swordsman
programme.desc: 獨臂刀方剛與妻子二人息隱歸田，但當方剛的妻子被擄走，他唯有被迫重出江湖對付武林惡黨「八大刀王」，以救回妻子。.

programme.title: 西廂記 / West Chamber
programme.desc: 張生、崔鶯鶯才子佳人相會，俏紅娘從中牽赤繩；西廂夜訪，私定終身；崔老夫人知情大怒，憤而拷紅；紅娘怨夫人不該言而無信，終成就百年姻緣。.

programme.title: 西廂記 / West Chamber
programme.desc: 張生、崔鶯鶯才子佳人相會，俏紅娘從中牽赤繩；西廂夜訪，私定終身；崔老夫人知情大怒，憤而拷紅；紅娘怨夫人不該言而無信，終成就百年姻緣。.

programme.title: 龍虎溝 / The Dragon Creek
programme.desc: 本片為導演岳楓於1966年執導之民初動作片，劇情主要描述，二妞收到父親遇害前寫下的仇人名單，遂連同兄長建明展開一幕奇情追凶….

programme.title: 風流韻事 / Illicit Desire
programme.desc: 本片講述了三個故事。《蕭翼賺蘭亭》講述唐太宗李世民收盡天下王羲之的書法，獨缺《蘭亭序》，御史蕭翼多才多藝，設計從辯才和尚那裡騙取《蘭亭序》......《蕙蓮》以林偉圖設計謀殺李鵬飛為序幕，以李在橋上看奇書《金瓶梅》展開劇情；而《小神仙》則又由偷牛、捉姦和小神仙同藥師之間的鬥法三個小故事組成。.

programme.title: 女俠賣人頭 / Heads For Sale
programme.desc: 俠女花碧蓮愛上鄰村的駱宏勛，其父花振芳去說親，卻遭駱母拒絕。碧蓮深心不忿，找上駱家，把宏勛打倒來消氣。後碧蓮為救人而得罪賭棍萬三句，萬率眾圍殺碧蓮，幸宏勛及時趕來相救。萬之主人王倫知悉一切後，重金收買知府，將宏勛打下冤獄。碧蓮往探監，見宏勛奄奄一息，遂隻身闖進王倫練武場，大戰眾強徒，並取下王倫助手首級。翌日，碧蓮把血淋淋的人頭掛在竹竿上，到市上去叫賣，結果驚動官差，被捉進衙門...

programme.title: 梅山收七怪 / Na Cha And The Seven Devils
programme.desc: 小哪吒偷吃了仙界桃樹的一個新結仙桃，但又不慎將另外七個仙桃弄落凡間，導致七隻不同動物變成妖怪。哪吒要在十天內收復妖怪，否則父親會被天帝懲罰。到底哪吒能否完成任務?

programme.title: 包剪石沓 / Melody of Love
programme.desc: 幽默風趣的愛情喜劇，三個年青醫生常開道、史瑞科、蕭而可，被安排追求院長的三個女兒靈珍、靈珊、靈玲。三人以「包、剪、搥」來決定追求對象，他們的追女橋段層出不窮，用盡英雄救美、苦肉計、死纏爛打等愛情藥方，卻全部失靈，烏龍百出...

programme.title: 琴劍恩仇 / The Sword And The Lute
programme.desc: 桂武和甘聯珠夫婦共闖江湖、報恩仇，得女俠紅姑之助，技藝大進，博得鴛鴦劍俠美名；桂甘今受紅姑所托，將殺人利器「鳳琴」送往家中；誰料途經飛虎寨，不慎以「鳳琴」射傷少寨主，當夜琴亦為神偷盜去...

programme.title: 女子公寓 / Apartment for Ladies
programme.desc: 故事背景為一幢女子公寓，房東陳太太痛恨男人，嚴禁男性進入，不幸，女房客卻多靠男性而活；歌女尤淑文由台北飛到香港，找尋失蹤的妹妹；尤經作曲家王德生介紹到居所樓上之女子公寓居住...

programme.title: 無名英雄 / The Anonymous Heroes
programme.desc: 這部發生在1911年辛亥革命以後的動作喜劇，講述兩名年青人無意中參加了革命活動而成為救國英雄。通過軍閥女兒的協助，兩人成功偷取軍閥的軍火，並送交到革命軍手中。.

programme.title: 紅樓夢 / The Dream of the Red Chamber
programme.desc: 這部電影改編自中國史上最廣受歡迎的文學作品《紅樓夢》，被譽為同名電影中最成功的作品。樂蒂生動地詮釋了美麗卻帶有一絲哀愁的林黛玉角色，也因此贏得了「古典美人」的美譽。.

programme.title: 暗渠 / Men From The Gutter
programme.desc: 故事講述偵緝警長趙敬才因一次行動，連累下屬被劫匪擊斃，而被上司指責處事魯莽，改派督察邱正明接辦案件。敬才與正明辦案作風迥異，衝突日多。職業殺手利子健受雇來港狙殺殷商徐文，豈料行動時卻誤中副車，僅殺死徐文之助手；當徐文查得殺手為子健後，急欲除之。警方接獲線報，即派正明與敬才率隊出發，阻止黑幫火拼…….

programme.title: 玉女親情 / A Place to Call Home
programme.desc: 故事講述張愛珠無意得知自己是孤兒，故往找生母。生母茱莉與流氓劉老四同居，老四心起歪念，竟欲非禮愛珠，茱莉救了女兒，卻被老四誤殺。愛珠逃回養父母家，始深深體會到養父母對她的愛。.

programme.title: 通天小子紅槍客 / The Kid With A Tattoo
programme.desc: 通天少爺李寶通乃棉胎店老闆李昌建之獨子，平素不服父親管教外，還經常整蠱作怪；古板嚴謹的李昌建，屢遭兒子作弄亦不自知。寶通經常暗中替喬裝乞丐的偵緝隊長陳英剛買食物，並向他學習武功；後英剛給「紅槍客」林飛殺死，寶通正好在暗處看見事發經過，並偷聽到林飛所透露的犯案者名字。此時，寶通行蹤被發現，幸寶通機智，得以逃脫，惟其胸部上的蒼鷹刺青已被林飛看到….

programme.title: 醜聞 / Scandal
programme.desc: 在河北省某貪汙成風的小縣內，流浪漢甄明與賈亮因掌握一眾縣官的貪汙和醜聞證據，得以順水推舟假扮縣長，把各官員玩弄於股掌之中，峰迴路轉，結局卻出人意表。全片除帶出人生如戲的黑色幽默，也狠狠地鞭撻為官者殘民以自肥的無恥行為。.

programme.title: Keluarga Somat
programme.desc: Serial Animasi Keluarga yang membahas kehidupan masyarakat sehari-hari melalui tokoh utama, Pak Somat , Bu Inah, Dudung, Ninung dan warga lainnya yang ber-Bhinneka Tunggal Ika.

programme.title: Petok Si Ayam Kampung
programme.desc: Serial Stop Motion tentang seekor ayam jantan ,bernama "Petok" yang beranjak dewasa, dan merasa dirinya tidak se-spesial hewan-hewan piaraan majikannya. Oleh karena itu Ia selalu berusaha menunjukkan kepada majikannya bahawa Ia adalah ayam yang serba bisa.

programme.title: Puzzle Code Of Shanmiao And Jimi
programme.desc: ShanMiao dan JiMi bekerja sama untuk memecahkan teka-teki sementara GuLi dan XinKe yang nakal terus membuat masalah! Malaikat kecil dan pengacau yang egois menghadapi tantangan dengan cara yang berbeda untuk mencapai impian mereka. Kode teka-teki, siapa yang akan menjadi pemenang akhir?

programme.title: Tim Penyelamat Tayo
programme.desc: Pergi tim penyelamat! Lindungi kota! Kendaraan penyelamat baru, mobil polisi, dan truk pemadam kebakaran datang untuk menyelamatkan!

programme.title: Howie, LandauS Adventures In Seabed
programme.desc: Seri ini menyampaikan nilai-nilai persahabatan, keberanian, keyakinan dan pengampunan kepada anak-anak dan menceritakan kisah-kisah yang dialami Howie dan Landau di dasar laut. Howie, seorang penemu cilik dan Landau, seorang ahli pengetahuan kelautan, pergi ke laut dalam secara tidak sengaja. Mereka datang ke Kerajaan Merman dan terlibat dalam krisis besar di dunia laut.

programme.title: Boboiboy
programme.desc: Ikuti petualangan pahlawan super muda BoBoiBoy, teman robotnya Ochobot, dan teman-teman berkekuatan super mereka, Gopal, Ying, dan Yaya, saat mereka bertarung untuk melindungi Bumi dari ancaman alien yang bertekad menaklukkan planet ini demi mendapatkan biji kakao.

programme.title: Bedu Dan Adul
programme.desc: Bedu dan Adul adalah sebuah serial film animasi 3D tentang petualangan anak-anak di kawasan pinggiran Jakarta.

programme.title: Arpo
programme.desc: Arpo dirancang sebagai robot komando, dibangun sebagai mesin tempur yang ganas. Namun, dengan tercapainya perdamaian dunia, Arpo telah diperlengkapi kembali untuk pengasuhan, diberi kode ulang untuk dipeluk, dan secara resmi dipindahkan sebagai robot pengasuh!

programme.title: Antiks
programme.desc: Serial ini menggambarkan bagaimana karakter-karakter ini selamat dari bahaya kehidupan sehari-hari, secara tidak sengaja mengubah situasi biasa menjadi peristiwa yang tidak terduga, luar biasa, dan selalu lucu.

programme.desc: Tema cerita Pororo dan kawan-kawan. Anda akan diajak ke desa Porong Porong, sebuah tempat yang penuh dengan petualangan.

programme.title: Kertas Ajaib
programme.desc: Seri ini menyampaikan nilai-nilai persahabatan, keberanian, keyakinan dan pengampunan kepada anak-anak dan menceritakan kisah-kisah yang dialami Howie dan Landau di dasar laut. Howie, seorang penemu cilik dan Landau, seorang ahli pengetahuan kelautan, pergi ke laut dalam secara tidak sengaja. Mereka datang ke Kerajaan Merman dan terlibat dalam krisis besar di dunia laut.

programme.title: Pokemon
programme.desc: Saatnya Ash dan Pikachu memulai petualangan mereka di wilayah Kalos! Sepanjang jalan, mereka bergabung dengan beberapa teman baru - seorang penemu jenius bernama Clemont, adik perempuannya Bonnie, dan Serena, seorang Pelatih dalam perjalanan pertamanya. Ash segera mencoba menantang Gym di Lumiose City, tetapi tidak terlalu jauh sebelum robot mengusirnya! Di sela-sela pertarungan Gym, Ash dan teman-temannya akan menjelajahi wilayah unik ini, bertemu semua jenis Pokemon baru, dan mencari misteri Pokemon baru yang menarik!

programme.desc: Cerita sinetron ini mengangkat pertemanan di dunia game online. Awalnya hanya sekadar main bareng, lama-lama menjadi jatuh cinta beneran. Cinta Sedalam Rindu?menceritakan Aluna (Esta Pramanita) yang menyembunyikan identitasnya di?game online?sebagai Gulagula. Tak disangka, ia dekat dengan Ezra (Farhan Rasyid) yang memakai nama Ezy. Ezra jatuh cinta dan ingin bertemu, tapi Aluna terus menghindar karena malu. Untuk mengetahui keseruan ceritanya saksikan tayangannya setiap hari, hanya di SCTV.

programme.title: Jejak Duka Diandra
programme.desc: Kisah cinta Diandra (Michelle Ziudith) dan Dimitri (Rio Dewanto) yang semula indah, seketika berubah drastis setelah Yunita (Baiti Syaghaf), saudara tiri Diandra mengaku mencintai Dimitri. Dimitri terjebak dalam situasi sulit akibat ulah sang adik, Jupiter (Bizael) yang menuduh Dimitri melecehkan Yunita. Hubungan Dimitri dengan Diandra pun semakin merenggang. Tuduhan lainnya juga harus diterima Dimitri sebagai penyebab insiden kecelakaan seorang wanita. Posisi Dimitri semakin terpojok setelah Diandra yang diminta sebagai saksi justru tidak berpihak kepadanya hingga Dimitri mendapat sanksi mendekam di balik jeruji besi selama lima tahun.Lima tahun berlalu, Dimitri hidup bebas dan melanjutkan usaha sang ayah. Ia pun membuka kisah cinta baru dengan Melissa (Tasya Panggabean). Takdir pun berkata lain, pertemuan Dimitri dan Diandra kembali terjadi...kisah selengkapnya, silakan saksikan hanya di SCTV.

Posisi Dimitri semakin terpojok setelah Diandra yang diminta sebagai saksi justru tidak berpihak kepadanya hingga Dimitri mendapat sanksi mendekam di balik jeruji besi selama lima tahun.Lima tahun berlalu, Dimitri hidup bebas dan melanjutkan usaha sang ayah. Ia pun membuka kisah cinta baru dengan Melissa (Tasya Panggabean). Takdir pun berkata lain, pertemuan Dimitri dan Diandra kembali terjadi...kisah selengkapnya, silakan saksikan hanya di SCTV.

programme.desc: Stanley helps Little Woo and Seamus fly their new kite. It gets stuck up a tree and breaks. Using leaves and sticks, they build a better one, only for that to get stuck.

programme.title: Cosmic Clean Up
programme.desc: When Stan and Violet ask Monty to tidy his room, they suggest he turn it into a game to make it more fun, but Monty begins to question whether its possible to turn a task like tidying into a game.

programme.title: Its Time to Make Ice Lollies
programme.desc: On a hot summer day, JoJo, Gran Gran and their friends are painting the fence around the community garden. JoJo and Gran Gran decide to buy ice lollies from Jareds shop, only to find he has run out!

programme.title: Fairy Tale
programme.desc: Dad tells Bluey and Bingo a real-life fairy tale about growing up in a wild place called the 80s, about a boy who was cursed when he was mean to his little brother.

programme.title: Musical Statues
programme.desc: At the end of a long day, Bluey and her family are out of sync and out of sorts, so Mum gets everyone to play musical statues.

programme.title: Stories
programme.desc: Indy thinks shes no good because her model horse looks like a cow, but Calypso encourages her not to give up, so she tries to fix it with a little help from Winton.

programme.title: The Wisdom Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels see Duggee reading about wise animals and wish to learn more about what it means to be wise.

programme.title: The Listening Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels hear a strange sound that theyve not heard before, so they ask Duggee to help identify it.

programme.title: Hey Quacky!
programme.desc: Worm and Ladybird wonder whats going on at Squirrel Club. Theres a gorilla playing drums, some helpful ducks, a hot frog, four goats and a hospital run by chicken doctors.

programme.title: The Jigokudani Monkey Park, Japan
programme.desc: The Go Jetters fly to the rescue in Japan, as Glitch gets up to his usual monkey business.

programme.title: Pepper
programme.desc: Pepper performs a bell ringing act.

programme.title: Peas
programme.desc: Two peas perform a happy song.

programme.title: Come Back Cobs
programme.desc: The Cobs have finally had enough of Evil Peas ungratefulness and team up with Supertato.

programme.title: Big Net Rescue
programme.desc: Carrot is determined to save Supertato from Evil Peas trap without help from Prickly Pear

programme.title: This Way, That Way
programme.desc: The Teletubbies go this way, that way on a Tubby Car journey to the Hidey Hup. The Tubby Spinny goes this way, that way too.

programme.title: Z
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say z, and we go on an adventure around the sound. We see some zips, do some zooming and see some zebras crossing a road!

programme.title: Vote Okido
programme.desc: Mayor Oki and Geoffrey are making a lot of noise in the election for the next Mayor of OKIDO.

programme.title: Mojo Drop the Ball
programme.desc: Preston needs to knock down his shed, and Mojo has the wrecking ball to do it. But first, Mojo and Bo have to get it all the way across town, which is harder than it sounds!

programme.title: Onesies
programme.desc: When mums sister Brandy comes over for a visit, she brings the kids onesies as a present, which has an unexpected effect on Bingo.

programme.title: Turtle Boy
programme.desc: Bingo finds a toy turtle at the playground and wants to take him home, but Dad says its not the right thing to do.

programme.title: The Cheerleading Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels find Duggees cheerleader pompoms, so he shows them his old moves. Time to practice: Duggee at the chess board, the Squirrels as a squad. Theres a big match ahead...

programme.title: The Midnight Badge
programme.desc: Loveable Duggee and the Squirrels return with more educational fun.

programme.title: Squirrel Babies
programme.desc: Spring has sprung! There are cute baby animals to meet and frolic with.

programme.title: Ladybirds Gameshow
programme.desc: Spot the odd one out or guess who lives here. A great memory tip from Duggee, an edition of The Agony and Eggstacy, and how to draw Enid - down to her last whisker.

programme.title: Central Park, New York
programme.desc: Glitch visits Broadway, while the Go Jetters tackle a huge cloud of smog in Central Park.

programme.title: Trampoline
programme.desc: When Dad has to stop having fun with the girls and go to work, Bluey and Bingo scramble to keep him playing games with them on the trampoline!

programme.title: The Quiet Game
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo are playing The Quiet Game and wont use words to tell Dad which toy to buy for Muffin. At his wits end, Dad recruits new store clerk Alfie to help interpret the girls miming.

programme.title: Andy and the Black Bear Cubs
programme.desc: In this episode, Andy, Jen and Scout head to Alaska, America on a baby animal mission to help rescue some black bear cubs high up in a tree. Along the way, Andy meets a grumpy Arctic ground squirrel.

programme.title: Mission: Mountain Biker
programme.desc: When a mountain biker called Eddie fails to come back from a ride with his friends, Dan and Jamie are called out on a night search.

programme.title: Galapagos Tortoise and Giant African Land Snail
programme.desc: This episode features the Galapagos tortoise and the giant African land snail - their wild connection is they carry their homes with them.

programme.title: Cats
programme.desc: Bella has fun pretending to be a cat - a Bella-Cat. Together with Lift, she visits Tincy the Spider in the Sing Song Forest, who sings a spider rhyme all about taily-waily animals!

programme.title: The What Happened Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels try and tell us what has just happened but are struggling to retell the tale

programme.title: The Building Block Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels become architects so they can bring to life their very own clubhouse.

programme.title: The Reunion Badge
programme.desc: Duggee hosts a reunion for the first ever Squirrels he looked after.

programme.title: Table Mountain, South Africa
programme.desc: Glitch wants to ski, so the Grimbots give Table Mountain a snowy peak, which threatens its rare plants.

programme.title: Mount Etna, Italy
programme.desc: When Grandmaster Glitch makes popcorn in Mount Etna, Italy, he blocks the volcano and endangers farms on its slopes.

programme.title: World of Tomorrow
programme.desc: When a pair of crooks steal plans for a great new invention, there is a high-speed chase to try and get them back and allow them to prove their worth.

programme.title: Ambitious Kung Fu Girl
programme.desc: Si Si, a spoiled and naive rich girl with only basic kung fu training, becomes enchanted by the legends of the fearless hero Qin Ge. Determined to escape her fathers arranged marriage, she disguises herself as a man and sets out to find him, hoping to challenge Qin Ge-only to be drawn into a deadly plot within the criminal underworld.

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: Ping and Su are lovers who operate a travel agency specializing in Southeast Asian holidays. Tung, a school mistress, and her students join a guided tour lead by Ping. During the trip, a spoiled kid Li is attracted to Ping but Su thinks Ping has fallen for Tung and leaves. How will Ping deal with the situation and ends up happily back with Su?

programme.title: The Golden Knight
programme.desc: The heroine Yu Fei Xia is accused of stealing the book of martial arts secrets. To prove her innocence, she disguises herself as a man and finds her way into the Shaolin Temple to find out the truth...

programme.title: Lets Fall In Love
programme.desc: Da Yung, the son of a rich entrepreneur, meets Lian Lian, the niece of a kindergarten principal by chance. They fall into a misunderstanding on the first meeting, causing Da Yung to lose his wallet. Further misunderstanding occurs when he tries to get her to act as his fiance so as to drive away two women whom he does not like...

programme.title: The Imperial Tomb Raiders
programme.desc: The story revolves around a maverick, a band of woman warriors and a group of ruthless bandits. The maverick teams up with the woman warriors to battle the bandits seeking to raid the emperors tomb.

programme.title: Between Tears and Smiles
programme.desc: Fan Jia Shu is a kind-hearted student who is smitten with Shen, a heart-rending love song singer. However, he is not the only one who has eyes for Shen. The Generals henchmen are also determined to present the songstress to their superior as a gift. Fan receives help from an unexpected person just in time to save the woman he loves.

programme.title: Raw Courage
programme.desc: After the Ming Emperor is overthrown and his infant son was put in the care of the Black Dragon Society, a traitorous martial arts clan attacks the society, forcing an inexperienced pair of swordsman and swordswoman to flee with the infant. Their journey to deliver the infant to safety is filled with dangers that would require help from other allies...

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: It is love beyond the grave, as a young scholar and his beautiful lover are torn apart forever by his dastardly uncle and his friend, who drive the girl to commit suicide... but with death comes revenge for the enchanting ghost. A spooky yet heart-wrenching tale...

programme.title: One-armed Swordsman
programme.desc: Accepted to the Golden Sword School after his father sacrificed his life to save his master, Fang Kang is resented by his fellow pupils and decides to leave. His masters daughter challenges him to a fight and cuts off his arm. Fang masters the art of sword fighting with one arm and finds himself returning to the School to save his master again.

programme.title: Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: An imperial minister Cheng betroths his pretty younger daughter, Ye, to his friends son, Mu. His wife however, refuses to let Ye marry before her elder daughter Yan, who is ugly and undesirable. Yan is asked to pretend as Ye to meet Mu but scares him away. A rich guy who likes Ye meanwhile pretends as Mu to attend the wedding...

programme.title: The Spirit of the Sword
programme.desc: Water Clan Chief is severely wounded by a samurai killer shortly before the annual duel at Tai Lake. He sends his brother Bao Yu on a long journey to find an antidote for him. On the way, Bao Yu encounters Little Princess and falls in love with her, not knowing that she is hiding a secret plot...

programme.title: Return Of The Dead
programme.desc: A long-awaited horror sequel after Enchanted Shadow, this is about three asylum inmates telling their stories. In story one, a husband and wife discover they should be careful what they wish for. A naked female ghost seeks revenge from her watery grave in story two, and a dead prostitute returns as a ghost in the last tale.

programme.title: Song Of Orchid Island
programme.desc: Dr. He moves to the remote Lanyu island off the coast of Taiwan to look for his long lost father, and starts to run a clinic curing islanders who are bitten by the fatal red worms there. He meets Ya Lan who works as a nurse in his clinic and falls in love with him. Things get vicious for Dr. He as a jealous islander plots to get rid of him...

programme.title: The Lady is the Boss
programme.desc: Wong Hsia Yuan is a traditional kung fu master whose academy is on the brink of closure. Chan Mei Ling arrives from U.S. to revitalize the academy but her way of recruiting students is going beyond questionably legal. Yuan is furious, but when the local triads enter the picture, Yuan and Ling join hands to take back the neighborhood.

programme.title: Brotherhood
programme.desc: Liu serves his triad society loyally and tries to live a respectable life, but over time his good intentions lead him to an all-out gang war with a startling conclusion.

programme.title: Sons Of Good Earth
programme.desc: This is an epic tale set during the time of the Sino-Japanese war. A painter Yu saves a young girl, Lotus, who is being sold to a brothel. They fall in love, get married and settled in to a peaceful life. However, their life is soon shattered by the Japanese invasion and the brutal regime that follows...

programme.title: Young Vagabond
programme.desc: One of the great Kung-fu film characters is "Beggar Su

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport zombies for a living and are hired to move nine zombies in one go. When two hop away, it is revealed that one is actually a man in disguise trying to escape his enemies. It turns out that both the disguised zombie and Chan are martial arts experts!

programme.title: Ghosts Galore
programme.desc: Young Taoist priest Lu and his friend are nearly killed by a female ghost during an exorcism. Luckily, Master Lian saves their lives, so they beseech him to teach them his skills. When his friend is killed by ruthless ninjas, Lu decides to learn the ultimate witchcraft and teams up with his master to defeat them.

programme.title: The Dancing Millionairess
programme.desc: Peter was a key dancer in a dance troupe and applied to be the chauffeur of a rich girl, Betty. When he is rumoured to be her lover, Betty is furious and goes undercover as a reporter to investigate the rumour. They fall in love in the process, and after putting Peter through many tests, they finally seal their love with a dance.

programme.title: The Web of Death
programme.desc: To rule the martial arts world, the Head of the Snake Sect seeks to possess a deadly plant called "Five Poison Web

programme.title: Lovers Blades
programme.desc: The Lovers Blades, a pair of invincible weapons, are to be delivered to the Qing Emperor. However, they accidentally fell into the hands of Xiao Zhong Hui and Yuan Guan Nan, so Imperial Chief Zhuo Tian Xiong hunts them down for the blades. As the battle begins, the secret of the blades are also revealed.

programme.title: Come Drink with Me
programme.desc: The brother of the mystery swordswoman "Golden Swallow" is kidnapped. She joins forces with a beggar "Drunken Cat" who is skilled in martial arts to free her brother from a Buddhist monastery run by a corrupt abbot. The film was selected as Hong Kongs entry for the Best Foreign Language Film at the 39th Academy Awards.

programme.title: The Twin Bracelets
programme.desc: Two teenage girls make a pledge to look after each other in a small Chinese fishing town, where the notions of womens rights or sexual freedom are absent. One ends up happily married to a stranger, while the other is cruelly betrothed to the abusive son of a wealthy family and has to seek to free herself from the situation.

programme.title: The Hidden Power Of Dragon Sabre
programme.desc: Defeated villain Sung Ching Shu returns and starts a reign of terror, trapping a beautiful Mongolian Princess and mastering the "yin and yang combination" to become almost invincible. Only two swords held by two great swordsmen can stand in his way!

programme.title: Moods Of Love
programme.desc: This Song Dynasty period piece about how far one would go for love (or lust) has two tales. The first involves a devilish magistrate who tries to tempt a Buddhist monk out of his self-professed celibacy by hiring a pretty prostitute. The second is the tragic tale of an exploited young girl who is forced to work in an unscrupulous couples brothel.

programme.title: The Venus Tear Diamond
programme.desc: Legendary rival jewel thieves Fragrant Night and Nocturnal Earl travel to Japan to steal the famous Venus Tear Diamond. They fall quickly in love at first sight, without knowing the other person is their rival and is after the same prize. Who will get the diamond, and will it mean the end of their new found love?

programme.title: Mr. Funnybone Strikes Again
programme.desc: In this hilarious sequel, Mr Big Potato opens an old-fashioned Chinese clinic, but his traditional methods are rejected by the sceptics of modern Hong Kong. Enter his buddy Mr Funny bone to rescue his business!

programme.title: The Flag of Iron
programme.desc: When super director Chang Cheh found new talent and blood with "The Five Venoms" actors, most of which were trained in the highly acrobatic Chinese opera and well versed with exotic martial arts weapons, this created a new spark for his use of bizarre weapons in his films. The Flag Of Iron is one of 20 movies that he directed featuring the utterly flabbergasting and physically exhausting action bits created by these five dudes.

programme.title: King Drummer
programme.desc: A young musician Chi Chiang is hired by the manager of a popular band when the groups drummer/leader Charlie, quits to join a rival group. The new drummer becomes an immediate hit, causing Charlie to be very jealous. Furthermore, the young drummers mother is dead set against him having a music career.

programme.title: The Golden Seal
programme.desc: Dai Tian Chou practices martial arts since young so he can avenge his fathers death. He meets Wu Xiao Yan who is disguised as a man one day and is suddenly beaten by a group of gangsters. Wu begs her father to allow her to take Dai back home to recover. Little does Dai know this is his chance to take revenge.

programme.title: The Tiger and the Widow
programme.desc: The Liu Chia-liang trained Hui Ying-hung was considered the top action martial arts female star in the 1980s. It is her martial arts abilities that Michelle Yeoh tries to emulate. In The Tiger and the Widow, Hui Ying-hung is somehow mixed up in a salt smuggling ring that stinks of missing persons and rotten dilemmas.

programme.title: Shadow Girl
programme.desc: A young swordswoman becomes invisible during the day and a monster at night after taking her grandmas pill. She ruined the wedding of a bandit chiefs daughter using her powers and is hunted down by them for revenge. Will she escape the hunt?

programme.title: Lady General Hua Mu-Lan
programme.desc: Mulan disguises herself as a male soldier to replace her aged father in a war against the barbarians. Her courage brings her victory in battles and she was promoted to a general. When Mulan returns home with glory, the chief commander asks her to marry his daughter, forcing Mulan to reveal her true identity.

programme.title: Crazy Nuts Of Kung Fu
programme.desc: A roadside bandit and a traveling gambler team up to make money from gambling. In a successful attempt to steal a huge amount of money from a warlords home, they encounter revolutionists who seek their help to fund the reform campaign. Will the two help the revolutionists cause with the stolen money?

programme.title: A Maid From Heaven
programme.desc: The seventh daughter of the Jade Emperor is banished from heaven to live a mortal life as she is very mischievous. She falls in love with a young village lad Yong, who sold himself to work for the rich so as to bury his father. The goddess sisters help Yong to pay his debt so the lovebirds can be together. Is this going to end happily-ever-after?

programme.title: Return of the One-armed Swordsman
programme.desc: One-armed Swordsman Fang Kang wants to lead a quiet life with his wife, but when she is abducted by the Eight Demon Swordsmen clan, he is forced to take them on in order to save her.

programme.title: To the Fore
programme.desc: The cycling teams top sprinter Zheng Zi Yuan teams up with two domestiques, Ming and Tian, who assist him to win the race. When Ming and Tian get tired of sacrificing their own chances to win, an accident causes the team to break up but the trio soon team up again for another race. Who will be the first to cross the line this time?

programme.title: Destinys Champion
programme.desc: An aging fighter relives the mistakes of his violent past through a poor and streetwise kid, who severely injures his nemesis during a battle to win a girls heart.

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from a famous Japanese manga. 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his fathers near-obsolete car every day and becomes a good racer with perfect drifting skill. Encouraged by his father, he joins a mountain race and unexpectedly wins it, making him famous overnight and leading him from one exciting race to another.

programme.title: Model from Hell
programme.desc: Anna, an exceptional student in a modelling school, becomes the target of envy from fellow models, who all die mysteriously when they want to harm her. It turns out that when Anna is upset, she undergoes a terrifying transformation and can wield lethal psychic power...

programme.title: Dream Lover
programme.desc: Ka Shing meets Kitty one day and they fall quickly in love. However, Kitty disappears shortly and when they meet years later, she is already married. To comfort himself, Ka Shing asks a mystic master to let Kitty appear in his dreams so that he can be with her constantly, even though she can only be his dream lover...

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: Shui and Tai are lovers who grew up together in a village but move to the city as Tais father disapproves of their relationship. Tai secretly works in a nightclub to help finance Shui to get the job of a salesman. When Shui is promoted for his good work and finds himself progressing in his career, he begins to feel distant from Tai...

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: This is based on the real-life story of Master Yu Jim Yuen who strives to run his academy in the 1960s, even as the opera culture is declining. Three young men, Sammo Hung, Jackie Chan and Yuen Biao, are determined to train under Master Yu and undergo extremely tough training before they become three of Hong Kongs biggest stars

programme.title: Man Wanted 3
programme.desc: Street kid Dong idolizes Mongkok triad leader Pu Jun and inadvertently joins his gang. When rival Xi Yang seizes control by illicit means, Pu Jun decides to take him down. At the same time, Pu Jun uncovers Dong as a police undercover and banishes him, but Dong sheds his undercover identity to join Pu Jun to seek revenge against Xi Yang.

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Taos house became haunted. Years later, Master Taos descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Lis daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: Mahjong Heroes
programme.desc: A hero helps a young student deflect a cunning and malicious gambling tycoon who is out to take over the students family business over a game of mahjong.

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bos magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: Kung Fu Mahjong 2
programme.desc: Fanny appears to be an ordinary housewife but is in fact a mahjong expert. Deeply in love with her husband, she loses to a seductive woman, Curvy, both on the mahjong table and in competing for her husbands love. With the help from her mahjong master, Fanny vows to take on Curvy in the Mahjong King tournament!

programme.title: Alls Well Ends Well Too
programme.desc: Another super comedy directed by Clifton Ko about more farcical couplings, mistaken identities, infidelities, and arranged marriages set in the Sung Dynasty.

programme.title: The Gambling Ghost
programme.desc: Sammo Hung plays three roles: Fatty, Fattys father and grandfather. Hoping to become rich, hotel staff Fatty dives into gambling with his friend to the dismay of his father. When Fatty hits rock bottom, his grandfathers ghost appears to help him. As Fatty finds out that his grandfather was murdered, he vows to avenge his death.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yis husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the "Happy Spinsters Club" set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: Law Or Justice
programme.desc: Lawyer Yip defends a rapist and gets him acquitted. Yips boyfriend Fong, a police inspector, knows he is guilty and despises Yip for not upholding justice. The victims sister takes revenge by spiking the rapists drink but is raped instead. This puts the rapist back in court. Will Yip choose to uphold law or justice this time?

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Wo Hu
programme.desc: The Hong Kong Police has placed more than a thousand undercover officers in various triad groups to bring down the largest criminal organization in Hong Kong. Betrayal, deceit and murder bring this group of "brothers" into a collision with the law and with each other!

programme.title: A Chinese Tall Story
programme.desc: While finding ways to rescue his disciples, Monk Tripitaka meets the lizard imp Mei Yan, the ugliest woman alive. Despite the conflict between good and evil, he falls for Mei Yan who sacrifices herself to save him many times. The Monk breaks his "no killing" rule to save his disciples, and things get more complicated as Princess Galaxy appears...

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: Heaven in the Dark
programme.desc: Michelle files for sexual harassment charges against Pastor To after they shared a passionate kiss, and this turns into a bitter court case. The pastor turns away from his faith thereafter, while Michelle becomes even more religious. When they meet again 5 years later, both of them realize that they have still not gotten over the incident.

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Beauty And The 7 Beasts
programme.desc: Teddy, once a renowned movie star, is facing a career decline. To make a living, he accepts five disciples to shape them into stars. Teddys career regains momentum after he reunites with his long-lost daughter, but he is also confronted by a rival at the same time. His daughter and disciples decide to help him overcome this difficult situation...

programme.title: Those Were the Days
programme.desc: Director Wong despises Cantonese movies of the 60s, but accidentally travels back in time to that movie set. He meets Director Chu, who tells him he can return to modern time if someone likes the film he makes. Wong meets four classic movie stars and invites them to star in his new film, but it flops unexpectedly. Can Wong return to the present?

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to "Casino Tycoon". 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down...

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Fat Choi Spirit
programme.desc: Andy is a mahjong master who is very popular in the neighbourhood. However, after being cursed by his ex-girlfriend, Andy always experiences bad luck when playing mahjong. Can he finally dodge this streak of bad luck?

programme.title: Dont Open Your Eyes
programme.desc: A cop has the ability to see ghosts, which is something that has been passed down from generation to generation in his family. He must learn how to manage this gift when he is confronted by the ghost of a notorious criminal whom he has shot.

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap. It is at this time that Chen falls for a beautiful girl May, who thinks he is a company chauffeur...

programme.title: The Myth
programme.desc: An archaeologist Jack, and a scientist William, stumble upon ancient Qin Dynasty artifacts that lead them to the mausoleum and mysteriously connects Jack to his past life as a warrior in ancient China, starting their mythical journey.

programme.title: 36 Secrets of Courtship
programme.desc: This erotic comedy features three lotharios who vie to become principal of the Macho Man Training School -- an extremely sexy institution dedicated to extremely non Shaolin-types of physical exertion.

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Rileys mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: Pups Find a Genie / Pups Save a Tightrope Walker
programme.desc: Rubble finds an old brass Jack in the Box, with a genie inside who grants him three wishes! // Francois Turbot is bravely walking a tightrope, but seagulls threaten to ruin his act. Time to call the PAW Patrol!

programme.title: Pups Save a Goldrush / Pups Save the Paw Patroller
programme.desc: When a grizzled old prospector discovers gold in Adventure Bay, its a bona fide, dog gone, gold rush! // When Mayor Humdinger and the Kit-tastrophe Crew try to steal the Paw Patroller, the chase becomes a rescue!

programme.title: Where Did It Go Barbabravo? / The Big Bad Hen
programme.desc: Like a secret agent, Barbabravo leads the investigation equipped with his gadgets to find out who stole Barbapapas cake. // Barbalala is convinced she heard a giant hen prowling around the house. The Barbababies organize themselves to stand guard.

programme.title: Clock and Dance / Barbapileup
programme.desc: The barbababies prepare a show for Barbamamas birthday. While Barbalala finishes up, they go to the carnival where Barbabeau gets stuck in an attraction. // Three separate stories telescope into a big final bouquet in the middle of the courtyard.

programme.title: Astropumpkin
programme.desc: Tim and Tommy try to grow the biggest Moon Pumpkin they can.

programme.title: Pets
programme.desc: Tim, Tia and Tommy try to convince Mum and Dad to let them have a pet.

programme.title: Tidy
programme.desc: Tim has a clearout of all his old stuff, but soon finds not all of it is destined for the rubbish bin.

programme.title: The Crew Builds A Train Station / The Crew Builds A Sierra Sparkle Sign
programme.desc: Rubble and Crew build the first train station in Builder Cove just in time to welcome Farmer Zoes new cow Mooreen. // Popstar Sierra Sparkle is moving to Builder Cove! But when the pups plan a surprise greeting, Speed Meister makes a plan of his own.

programme.title: The Crew Builds A Mini Golf Course/The Crew Builds A Butterfly Garden
programme.desc: When a family of bunnies hops onto the soccer field, Rubble and Crew use their skills to build a new sport... Bunny Ball! // After the pups discover a new kind of butterfly, it flutters away! Will a giant butterfly garden help bring it back?

programme.title: The Alebrije Adventure / Lets Get A Paleta
programme.desc: Ale the Alebrije asks Dora for her help! The Alebrije tree is wilting, so its up to Dora to find its rainbow water. // On a super hot day, everyone wants paleta, but Vals paleta truck is stuck! Dora goes to rescue her and get paletas for everyone.

programme.title: The Weather Machine
programme.desc: Its race day in Axle City, but Crusher has stolen Gabbys Weather Machine and is using it to cheat up a storm! Now, Blaze, AJ and Gabby will have to weather Crushers cheats to win the race and get Gabbys machine back, one and for all!

programme.title: The Rocketship Ride
programme.desc: Darington cant wait to ride the Great Rocketship Ride, the tallest, fastest carnival ride in all of Axle City! But when Daringtons tickets blow away, he and Blaze must go on an epic adventure to retrieve them!

programme.title: Greedyguts / Where is Bali?
programme.desc: A goat has escaped from the mountain and is coming to wreak havoc, devouring everything in its path! // Bali is nowhere to be found, and the Barbapapa deploy all their imagination to look for her. They have no idea that a nice surprise awaits them!

programme.title: Barbabright Has a Secret / Super Duper Cool
programme.desc: Barbabright acts strangely. What is he hiding ? The Barbabbabies will do anything to find out. // The Barbapapa decide to save energy. But their efforts are undermined by Barbabright and Barbabelle who build a secret energy-consuming project.

programme.title: Explorer / Happy Parky / Storm
programme.desc: Tim explores Rumbleton to find somewhere he can have fun alone. // Tim and Kai try to give Parky the best day ever. // When a storm keeps the Rexes at home they must think of a game to pass the time.

programme.title: The Pickle Family Campout
programme.desc: When all the members of Pickles family get lost in the woods, Pickle teams up with Tow Truck Blaze to come to their rescue!

programme.title: The Chicken Circus!
programme.desc: Blaze, AJ, and Darington are in the front row for the amazing Chicken Circus! But when Crusher accidentally launches the chickens far, far away, its up to Blaze and Darington to get their feathered friends back to the big top!

programme.title: The Crew Builds A School / The Crew Builds A Waterway
programme.desc: Its the first day of school in Builder Cove... if Rubble and Crew can finish the building in time! / The pups need a construction solution to save Farmer Zoes crops and to keep Crunchy the beaver from taking all the water!

programme.title: The Crew Builds An Observatory / The Crew Builds A Zipline
programme.desc: The pups jump into action to build an observatory to help their friend River get a cool picture of a shooting star! // After meeting Park Ranger Rose, the pups get stuck on a nature trail. But Rubble and Crew, finds a construction solution.

programme.title: Pups Save a Disappearing Flounder / Pups Save Little Grandpa and Mr. Alex
programme.desc: When Capn Turbots ship disappears, the Paw Patrol must venture into the mysterious Adventure Bay Triangle to find the missing vessel. // When Alex and Mr. Porter swap roles, the pups must help track down the Mini-Patrol after they go missing.

programme.title: Pups Save the Elephant Spa / Pups Save an Underwater Otis
programme.desc: While trying to save Traveling Travis, Ryder and the pups stumble across the legendary Elephants Spa. // Uncle Otis believes hes found gold but when Sid the Pirate tries to jump on Otiss claim, Otis gets trapped in a sunken shipping container.

programme.title: The Rainforest Ritmo / The Magic Nut
programme.desc: Isas throwing a party where everyone will be dancing the Rainforest Ritmo. Boots has to learn the dance before they get there! // Dora leads everyone into the Tricky Trappy Forest to recover Ticos magic nut that can turn into your favorite food.

programme.title: Abuelas Quinceanera

programme.title: A Perfect Man
programme.desc: Yeung Yat-cheng (Joe Ma) has a good reputation in the realm of personal security. He is invited by his buddy Ha Chung-chau (Tsui Wing) to join a security company that is tasked with protecting a tycoon called Tseung Ding-tin (KK Cheung). While starting his new job, Yat-cheung is faced with personnel issues. Meanwhile, due to his unhappy childhood, Yat-cheng does not believe in marriage. However, he happens to hook up with Yau Chi-ching (Ali Lee).

programme.title: A STEP INTO THE PAST
programme.desc: HONG SHIU LUNG (KOO TIN LOK, LOUIS) is an secret agent in the 21st Century. He joins a pilot programme to fly back in time hoping that he will salvage his unforgettable love. However, something goes wrong during the mission. He is sent back to the Warring States Period. Emperor QI (LAM RAYMOND) has not been crowned yet and is kept hostage in Chiu. In order to return to the future, LUNG decides to help QI become emperor. With his wisdom and Kungfu, he is recognized and given important tasks.

programme.title: Plain Love II
programme.desc: ‘Fong’s tea’ is regarded as the finest in the trade. However, due to downfall of the family, its successor Yau Wai (Lam Ka Tung) can only earn his living by farming. WAI has two best friends, Hon Ngau (Mak Cheung Ching) and Wing Chun (Li Ka Sing, Dickson). They even become sworn brothers, share both happiness and bitterness._x000D_The three of them work in a huge tea garden of Sung’s family. Wai meets Ngai Mui (Cheung Ho Yee, Maggie) again, a girl from highlands.
