programme.title: Shades of Life
programme.desc: Ko Ba-dou (Yu Yang), a retired school principal with a deep love for traditional Chinese culture, values ​​family ethics and is highly respected by his family. His eldest son, Ko Ho-pan (Wu Nuoyan), a journalism graduate and magazine editor, is a prodigy who seeks to get to the bottom of things. On livelihood issues, he occasionally disagrees with his father, holding different views.

programme.title: Knot To Treasure
programme.desc: Wei (Zhu Jiang), the eldest son of Wei (Chen Jiewen), is wild and untamed. Under family pressure, he finally marries Shan (Zhang Fengni), with whom he has been dating for many years. After their marriage, Yat-sen develops an extramarital affair with Yan (Cui Jiabao), eventually living with her and abandoning Shan. Later, realizing Yans overly open attitude towards relationships, he decides to pursue Shan again.

programme.title: Bottled Passion
programme.desc: MRS. KO TUNG KWOK-HING (Chan Sau Chu) lies to her husband KO SHIU-TONG (Kwok Fung) that the orphan boy she brings home is his long lost illegal son, KO YEE-HO. TONG believes HO will make a better heir than his elder son, KO YEE-TAI (Chan Shan Chung), resulting in HING’s kicking HO out of the house in anger. HO has been living a vagabond life since. After having enough of the bitter taste of life, he is determined to let the KO family know how it feels to lose one’s family.

Then, suddenly and mysteriously, FUNG, who is believed to be dead, turns up again, which makes the enigma even more intriguing. His eldest son, Ko Ho-pan (Wu Nuoyan), a journalism graduate and magazine editor, is a prodigy who seeks to get to the bottom of things. On livelihood issues, he occasionally disagrees with his father, holding different views.

programme.title: Knot To Treasure
programme.desc: Wei (Zhu Jiang), the eldest son of Wei (Chen Jiewen), is wild and untamed. Under family pressure, he finally marries Shan (Zhang Fengni), with whom he has been dating for many years. After their marriage, Yat-sen develops an extramarital affair with Yan (Cui Jiabao), eventually living with her and abandoning Shan. Later, realizing Yans overly open attitude towards relationships, he decides to pursue Shan again.

programme.title: Bottled Passion
programme.desc: MRS. KO TUNG KWOK-HING (Chan Sau Chu) lies to her husband KO SHIU-TONG (Kwok Fung) that the orphan boy she brings home is his long lost illegal son, KO YEE-HO. TONG believes HO will make a better heir than his elder son, KO YEE-TAI (Chan Shan Chung), resulting in HING’s kicking HO out of the house in anger. HO has been living a vagabond life since. After having enough of the bitter taste of life, he is determined to let the KO family know how it feels to lose one’s family.

programme.title: Happy Ever After
programme.desc: TUNG KOON (AU YEUNG CHUN WAH, BOBBY) born with a special ‘King’s Tongue’ is betrayed by his assistant, SIU SIU (CHAN MIU YING, MARIANE) who had prepared some chili source without permission. TUNG is accused of deceiving the Emperor and is forced to flee from Guangzhou to the capital. When SIU discovered that someone had used her to trap TUNG, she sees TUNG in person and apologizes. TUNG and SIU eventually reconcile. Love feeling blossoms between them.

programme.title: LEscargot
programme.desc: Renovation contractor KWAN KA-ON (Miu Kiu Wai) is the elder of four siblings, while his wife SZE LONG-KIU (Sonija Kwok) is a typical housewife. Buying a house is their longtime dream. But when his eldest brother, KWAN KA-HONG’s business goes under, they shelve their plan to help him overcome his difficulties. KIU has to look for a job too.

programme.title: A Perfect Man
programme.desc: Yeung Yat-cheng (Joe Ma) has a good reputation in the realm of personal security. He is invited by his buddy Ha Chung-chau (Tsui Wing) to join a security company that is tasked with protecting a tycoon called Tseung Ding-tin (KK Cheung). While starting his new job, Yat-cheung is faced with personnel issues. Meanwhile, due to his unhappy childhood, Yat-cheng does not believe in marriage. However, he happens to hook up with Yau Chi-ching (Ali Lee).

programme.title: A STEP INTO THE PAST
programme.desc: HONG SHIU LUNG (KOO TIN LOK, LOUIS) is an secret agent in the 21st Century. He joins a pilot programme to fly back in time hoping that he will salvage his unforgettable love. However, something goes wrong during the mission. He is sent back to the Warring States Period. Emperor QI (LAM RAYMOND) has not been crowned yet and is kept hostage in Chiu. In order to return to the future, LUNG decides to help QI become emperor. With his wisdom and Kungfu, he is recognized and given important tasks.

programme.title: Sampai Nanti
programme.desc: Kyle dan Milly bertemu kembali setelah 10 tahun terpisah dan cinta lama kembali terjalin. Tetapi adakah cinta mereka akan terus kekal hingga ke akhirnya?

programme.title: Asam Pedas Cendol Sejoli
programme.desc: Karim adalah pemilik kedai cendol bersebelahan dengan kedai asam pedas Kalsom. Mereka bermusuhan, tetapi anak mereka – Kinah dan Khalil – mencintai satu sama lain, dan terpaksa menyembunyikan perkara ini bagi mengelakkan perang antara dua kedai mereka.

programme.title: Tolong Saya Encik Dinosaur
programme.desc: Elly berpindah dari bandar ke pekan kecil untuk mencari ketenangan. Tetapi kenangan buruk tetap menghantui dirinya, sehinggalah dia bertemu dengan Karl yang mengajarnya erti sebuah kebahagiaan.

programme.title: Cubit - Cubit Cinta

programme.title: Biarkan Cinta Tersenyum Lagi

programme.title: Ayat Dari Langit

programme.desc: Suraya is a naive village girl who looks forward to happy days when Hazrul proposes to her. But those happy days are only temporary when she learns who Hazrul really is.

programme.title: 6 Hari
programme.desc: Suzi is content with being a third wife and living alone in her bungalow as she only entertains her husband every 6 days. Everything comes crashing when a person from her past returns to her life.

programme.desc: Erin dan Ejot sering dibandingkan dari segi paras rupa. Sehingga suatu hari sesuatu telah berlaku kepada Erin yang mengubah segalanya.

programme.title: Diam Tanda Setuju
programme.desc: Kisah dua sahabat baik yang berhadapan dengan konflik perhubungan di saat mereka mula panik memikirkan usia mereka yang semakin meningkat tetapi belum bertemu jodoh.

programme.title: Nasiya
programme.desc: Ketika melarikan diri dari bekas suaminya, Ihyana telah mengalami kemalangan tetapi dia bernasib baik kerana telah diselamatkan oleh satu entiti luar biasa yang telah mengubah kelakuannya.

programme.title: Suamiku Encik Beruang
programme.desc: Ani, the most beautiful girl in the village, who is ever man's fantasy, decides to marry Mr. Bear as her husband, much to everyone's surprise. As for the chief village, he intend to organise the "wedding of the year".

programme.title: Menanti Hari Itu
programme.desc: Kisah kasih sayang seorang ibu terhadap anak kandungnya yang tidak pernah terpadam meskipun si anak menjauhkan diri akibat hasutan keluarga angkatnya sendiri.

programme.title: Kecundang Sebelum Menjanda
programme.desc: Hari terbahagia dalam hidup Nora berubah menjadi suram bila tunangnya menarik diri pada hari pernikahan mereka. Tambah buruk lagi, hari selepas tragedi itu asyik berulang atas sebab-sebab misteri.

programme.title: Aku Raja Lawak
programme.desc: Silah nak jadi pelawak yang terkenal, cuma di kampungnya tak ada peluang pekerjaan pelawak sepenuh masa. Tapi dia tetap mendapat sokongan padu daripada peminat nombor satunya – iaitu Faris, anaknya.

programme.title: Puyah & Putat
programme.desc: Kisah pengembaraan Puyah, seorang gadis kampung becok yang disukai ramai, apabila dia melawat Kuala Lumpur dan termasuk set filem secara tak sengaja, dan tak semena-mena mula mendapat nama sebagai pelakon.

programme.title: Ting Tong, Love
programme.desc: Bored by his mother's insistence on his getting married, Hairi finally agrees on the condition that he could choose his own soul mate. Does the choice of Hairi meet with his mother's approval?

programme.title: Chomel
programme.desc: After her mother's death, Mimi's family fell apart. One day, Mimi finds Chomel, a cat and brings it home, only for it to cause a series of events that brings her broken family back together again.

programme.title: My Future Husband
programme.desc: Emily berharap untuk menemui bakal suami dan pada suatu hari muncul seorang lelaki bernama Atta yang mengaku dia adalah suami Emily dari masa hadapan.

programme.title: Perangkap Perkahwinan
programme.desc: Three best friends promised to get married, at the same time when they turn 26 years old. Their perceptions of marriage life begin to change and conflict ensues.

programme.title: We’ll be back at 6.00am
programme.desc: We’ll be back at 6.00am.

programme.title: Cik Puan Sinderella
programme.desc: This is a lighthearted family drama about a teenage girl who is closely guarded by her mother.

programme.title: Anak Kerak
programme.desc: Husin telah menggunakan ilmu hitam iaitu dengan ‘Anak Kerak' demi untuk mendapatkan kekebalan, kesenangan dan kemewahan hidup di dunia.

programme.title: Jatuh Cinta Buta
programme.desc: Telefilem komedi romantik tentang perkenalan singkat di antara Zulin, seorang gadis yang tidak pernah bercinta, dengan Izlan, seorang duda dalam satu 'blind date' yang diaturkan oleh Nadya Ramanshah.

programme.title: Matahari
programme.desc: Fauzi seorang guru yang telah dihantar untuk berkhidmat di Sabah. Di sana dia telah berkenalan dengan seorang novelis yang sedang mengalami masalah ‘writer’s block’ iaitu Yazid.

programme.title: Meniti Cinta Di Starimost
programme.desc: Iman dipaksa berkahwin dengan Qaseh, anak kepada orang gajinya untuk mewarisi harta bapanya. Percutian mereka di Bosnia membuahkan bibit-bibit cinta. Lakonan Iqram Dinzly, Zarina Zainoordin dan Yana Shamsudin.

programme.title: Jula Juli Bintang Putus Cinta
programme.desc: Telemovie sekuel Jula Juli Bintang Cinta kini kembali! Kali ini, Jula dan Juli mengalami konflik percintaan dengan Dani & Izham sehingga mereka memutuskan untuk berpisah dan melarikan diri ke kampung Juli.

programme.title: Kampung Kuala Lambat
programme.desc: Kampung Kuala Lambat bagai mengalami sumpahan apabila lelaki yang berkahwin muda akan mati di hari pernikahan mereka namun kejadian ganjil ini tidak berlaku kepada lelaki yang berusia 60 tahun ke atas.

programme.title: Musnahkan Pelamin Anganku
programme.desc: Mikael yang merupakan seorang wedding planner menerima tawaran besar untuk menjayakan sebuah majlis perkahwinan pelanggannya. Namun majlis perkahwinan tersebut merupakan majlis bekas isterinya.

programme.title: Dua
programme.desc: Kisah Farhan yang kehilangan kembarnya Fahrin dalam satu kemalangan tragis. Dia kemudiannya mengambil-alih kehidupan Fahrin namun terperangkap dalam sebuah cinta tiga segi pula. Lakonan Eusoff Hashim dan Sharifah Sakinah.

programme.title: Racun Menantu
programme.desc: After marrying Zain, Sara lived in the same house with Pak Dolah, her father-in-law. Because of the family's grudge, Sara started making trouble by seducing her own father-in-law.

programme.title: Cupid
programme.desc: Kisah mengenai seorang ejen yang bekerja di sebuah syarikat penghancur jodoh yang ditugaskan untuk memikat seorang wanita supaya dapat melupakan suaminya yang telah diisytiharkan meninggal dunia. Namun dia jatuh cinta pada wanita tersebut.

programme.title: Cerai
programme.desc: Pengalaman berkurung dengan pasangan selama musim PKP memaksa dua pasangan suami isteri menilai semula perkahwinan mereka yang telah disalah ertikan selama ini.

programme.title: Hingga Jumpa Lagi
programme.desc: Eva is diagnosed with cancer and prays that she could travel back to the past in order to prevent the love between her and her husband so that her husband can lead a happy life. Her prayer is granted….

programme.title: We’ll be back at 6.00am
programme.desc: We’ll be back at 6.00am.

programme.title: I Heart You Cik Yah
programme.desc: Zulkefli and Badariah are always arguing, but in order to prevent the factory where they work from being closed by Qarina, they must work together. Out of hatred, they start feeling for each other.

programme.title: Jihan Nak Displin Anak
programme.desc: Jihan dan suami kalut apabila anak mereka tidak mahu pulang beraya di kampung. Mereka cuba untuk mendisiplinkan anak mereka sebelum hari raya.

programme.title: Satu Kampung Dua Orang
programme.desc: Selepas banjir besar melanda, semua penduduk kampung berpindah kerana kampung mereka tidak lagi selamat. Hanya dua beradik yang enggan berpindah atas sebab dan alasan mereka tersendiri.

programme.title: Jamil Balik Kampung
programme.desc: Kisah perjalanan Jamil pulang ke kampung untuk meminang kekasihnya setelah pinangannya pernah ditolak beberapa kali. Berjayakah misi Jamil kali ini?

programme.title: Sampai Nanti
programme.desc: Kyle dan Milly bertemu kembali setelah 10 tahun terpisah dan cinta lama kembali terjalin. Tetapi adakah cinta mereka akan terus kekal hingga ke akhirnya?

programme.title: Asam Pedas Cendol Sejoli
programme.desc: Karim adalah pemilik kedai cendol bersebelahan dengan kedai asam pedas Kalsom. Mereka bermusuhan, tetapi anak mereka – Kinah dan Khalil – mencintai satu sama lain, dan terpaksa menyembunyikan perkara ini bagi mengelakkan perang antara dua kedai mereka.

programme.title: Tolong Saya Encik Dinosaur
programme.desc: Elly berpindah dari bandar ke pekan kecil untuk mencari ketenangan. Tetapi kenangan buruk tetap menghantui dirinya, sehinggalah dia bertemu dengan Karl yang mengajarnya erti sebuah kebahagiaan.

programme.title: Cubit - Cubit Cinta
programme.desc: Kupid Cubit is a dating app that enables the masses to find love. But for Katarina and Saiful, it's a platform for healing people with unrequited love.

programme.title: Duit Kawin
programme.desc: Memaparkan pemikiran remaja sekarang terhadap perkahwinan dari sudut kos atas syariat agama tetapi tertekan cara hidup zaman kini yang mahukan kemewahan.

programme.title: Biarkan Cinta Tersenyum Lagi
programme.desc: Kisah penulis lagu Maya Arisa yang menghidap tumor otak dan mengimpikan untuk berkahwin. Dia kemudiannya bertemu dengan seorang jurugambar bernama Redza.

programme.title: Ayat Dari Langit
programme.desc: Ustaz Muiz dan isterinya mengajar ajaran sesat dan mahu pengikutnya mengikut telunjuk mereka yang lama kelamaan mula membuatkan pengikutnya bernama Kamal mula merasa sangsi.

programme.desc: Farid is a nerdy guy who always been bullied by Syakirin, his senior. Farid determined to enter an MMA tournament organized by their university so to put an end to being bullied by Syakirin.

programme.title: Racun Suami Jahanam
programme.desc: Suraya is a naive village girl who looks forward to happy days when Hazrul proposes to her. But those happy days are only temporary when she learns who Hazrul really is.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: An actual witch (Nicole Kidman) and a neurotic movie star (Will Ferrell) land the lead roles in a television remake of the 1960s sitcom. Starring Nicole Kidman, Will Ferrell, Shirley MacLaine.

programme.title: Practical Magic
programme.desc: Raised by their aunts, two sisters born into a magical family use different means to avoid a family legacy of witchcraft. Starring Sandra Bullock, Nicole Kidman, Dianne Wiest.

programme.title: Spartacus: House of Ashur
programme.desc: Achillia prepares for her return to the arena, while Ashur faces a devastating setback.

programme.title: The BMF Documentary: Blowing Money Fast
programme.sub-title: With the Streets Comes the Violence
programme.desc: Caught in a longstanding neighborhood rivalry, Terry is shot, prompting the brothers to shift from street level sales to wholesale in a bid to escape the violence; a move that ultimately begins to draw the attention of law enforcement.

programme.title: Flight Risk
programme.desc: A U.S. marshal boards a small plane to transfer a government witness to New York. As they cross the Alaskan wilderness, tensions start to rise as not everyone on the flight is who they appear to be. Starring Mark Wahlberg, Michelle Dockery, Topher Grace.

programme.title: French Exit
programme.desc: A widowed New York socialite and her aimless son move to Paris after she spends the last of her husbands inheritance. Starring Michelle Pfeiffer, Lucas Hedges, Tracy Letts.

programme.title: Neighbors
programme.desc: A young couple suffering from arrested development are forced to live next to a fraternity house after the birth of their newborn baby. Starring Seth Rogen, Zac Efron, Rose Byrne.

programme.title: Knocked Up
programme.desc: A rising journalist (Katherine Heigl) and an irresponsible slacker (Seth Rogen) ponder their future after a boozy one-night stand results in a pregnancy. Starring Seth Rogen, Katherine Heigl, Paul Rudd.

programme.title: Perfect High
programme.desc: A teens (Bella Thorne) life spirals out of control when she starts abusing painkillers and heroin with her new friends (Israel Broussard, Daniela Bobadilla) from school. Starring Bella Thorne, Israel Broussard, Daniela Bobadilla.

programme.title: Spider-Man
programme.desc: Peter Parker (Tobey Maguire) uses his superhuman powers to battle his archenemy, the Green Goblin (Willem Dafoe). Starring Tobey Maguire, Willem Dafoe, Kirsten Dunst.

programme.title: Spider-Man 2
programme.desc: Tormented Peter Parker battles a sinister scientist who uses mechanical tentacles for destructive purposes. Starring Tobey Maguire, Kirsten Dunst, James Franco.

programme.title: Spider-Man 3
programme.desc: Peter Parker undergoes an ominous transformation when his Spider-Man suit turns black and brings out the dark, vengeful side of his personality. Starring Tobey Maguire, Kirsten Dunst, James Franco.

programme.title: Superman
programme.desc: Jor-El (Marlon Brando) of Krypton sends his baby to Earth, where he grows up as Clark Kent (Christopher Reeve) and works at the Daily Planet. Starring Christopher Reeve, Gene Hackman, Marlon Brando.

programme.title: Superman II
programme.desc: The Man of Steel (Christopher Reeve) gets serious with Lois Lane (Margot Kidder) and fights three Krypton outcasts in league with Lex Luthor (Gene Hackman). Starring Christopher Reeve, Margot Kidder, Gene Hackman.

programme.title: Superman III
programme.desc: Ersatz kryptonite laced with tobacco tar splits Superman (Christopher Reeve) in two: good Clark Kent and bad Man of Steel. Starring Christopher Reeve, Richard Pryor, Robert Vaughn.

programme.title: Salvable
programme.desc: A battered boxer finds his dreams and relationships on the ropes when he falls back in with a dangerous crowd. Starring Toby Kebbell, Shia LaBeouf, James Cosmo.

programme.title: Alarum
programme.desc: Living off the grid while vacationing at a winter resort, married spies Joe and Lara come under fire from members of the old guard who suspect theyve joined an elite team of rogue spies. Starring Scott Eastwood, Sylvester Stallone, Willa Fitzgerald.

programme.title: When Night Is Falling
programme.desc: A bisexual mythology professor (Pascale Bussières) has an affair with a circus performer (Rachael Crawford) she met at a laundromat. Starring Pascale Bussières, Rachael Crawford, Henry Czerny.

programme.title: Mad Max: Fury Road
programme.desc: Fortified in a massive, armored truck, loner Mad Max joins Imperator Furiosa and her band of rebels as they try to outrun a warlord and his henchmen in a deadly high-speed chase through the wasteland. Starring Tom Hardy, Charlize Theron, Nicholas Hoult.

programme.title: Poor Boys Game
programme.desc: While preparing for a boxing match, an ex-convict receives support from the man whose son he beat up. Starring Rossif Sutherland, Danny Glover, Greg Bryk.

programme.title: One Day in the Life of Noah Piugattuk
programme.desc: A government agent tries to get an Inuit man and his children to move to settlement housing. Starring Kim Bodnia, Apayata Kotierk, Benjamin Kunuk.

programme.title: The Princess Bride
programme.desc: A storybook stableboy turns pirate (Cary Elwes) and rescues his beloved (Robin Wright), who is about to marry a dreadful prince. Starring Cary Elwes, Robin Wright, Mandy Patinkin.

programme.title: Best in Show
programme.desc: Pampered pooches and their quirky owners converge on Philadelphia to compete in a prestigious dog show. Starring Michael Hitchcock, Parker Posey, Eugene Levy.

programme.title: A Mighty Wind
programme.desc: In order to honor his late father, a man (Bob Balaban) reunites various musicians (Christopher Guest, John Michael Higgins) to perform folk music at a tribute concert. Starring Bob Balaban, Christopher Guest, John Michael Higgins.

programme.title: Shrek

programme.title: Novak Djokovics Top 10
programme.sub-title: 2007 Canadian Open Final: Novak Djokovic v Roger Federer
programme.desc: At the 2007 Canadian Open, Novak Djokovic defeated the worlds top three players in successive matches en route to his second Masters title, including victory in the final over Federer.

programme.title: Novak Djokovics Top 10
programme.sub-title: 2009 Paris Masters Final: Novak Djokovic v Gael Monfils
programme.desc: In one of the most dramatic finals Bercy has ever seen, Novak Djokovic and Gael Monfils went toe to toe in a tightly fought, three-set battle for the 2009 Rolex Paris Masters title.

programme.title: Novak Djokovics Top 10
programme.sub-title: 2011 Madrid Open Final: Novak Djokovic v Rafael Nadal
programme.desc: In the 2011 Madrid Open final at the Caja Magica, Novak Djokovic inflicted the first clay-court defeat on Rafael Nadal in nearly two years to claim his fifth title of the year.

programme.title: Novak Djokovics Top 10
programme.sub-title: 2011 US Open Final: Novak Djokovic v Rafael Nadal
programme.desc: During a year in which Novak Djokovic dominated Rafael Nadal, one of the Serbs most high-profile victories over the legendary Spaniard came in the final of the 2011 US Open.

programme.title: Novak Djokovics Top 10
programme.sub-title: 2012 Shanghai Masters Final: Novak Djokovic v Andy Murray
programme.desc: After saving five championship points, Novak Djokovic roared back to dethrone the two-time reigning Shanghai Masters champion Andy Murray in an epic, three-set 2012 thriller.

programme.title: Novak Djokovics Top 10
programme.sub-title: 2012 ATP Finals Final: Novak Djokovic v Roger Federer
programme.desc: With the 2012 season-ending title on the line at the O2 Arena, two-time defending champion Roger Federer looked to deny world number one Novak Djokovic a second ATP world title.

programme.title: Novak Djokovics Top 10
programme.sub-title: 2013 Monte Carlo Masters Final: Novak Djokovic v Rafael Nadal
programme.desc: In the 2013 final of the Monte-Carlo Rolex Masters, Novak Djokovic brought an end to Rafael Nadals eight-year reign as champion in the Principality.

programme.title: Novak Djokovics Top 10
programme.sub-title: 2014 Indian Wells Final: Novak Djokovic v Roger Federer
programme.desc: Fighting back to beat the great Roger Federer, a 26-year-old Novak Djokovic clinched his third Indian Wells title in a riveting 2014 final that went all the way to a third-set tie-break.

programme.title: Novak Djokovics Top 10
programme.sub-title: 2023 Cincinnati Masters Final: Novak Djokovic v Carlos Alcaraz
programme.desc: Out to avenge the five-set Wimbledon final defeat inflicted by the Spaniard, Novak Djokovic finally overcame Carlos Alcaraz in just under four hours in the 2023 Cincinnati final.

programme.title: Novak Djokovics Top 10
programme.sub-title: 2023 US Open Final: Novak Djokovic v Daniil Medvedev
programme.desc: In a repeat of the 2021 final, the winner on that day, Daniil Medvedev, fought three-time champion Novak Djokovic in the final of the 2023 mens singles at the US Open.

programme.title: Novak Djokovics Top 10
programme.sub-title: 2025 Geneva Open Final: Novak Djokovic v Hubert Hurkacz
programme.desc: In what was a chance for Novak Djokovic to join Jimmy Connors and Roger Federer in winning a 100th tour-level title, the 38-year-old Serb battled Hubert Hurkacz in the Geneva Open final.
